soru_metni: Oliver: The gig economy offers freelancers absolute freedom to choose their working hours and projects. Emma: ______ Oliver: That's the major downside. The trade-off for flexibility is a lack of job security and healthcare benefits.
secenekler: Many young professionals prefer gig work over structured office jobs.
But it also means they have no steady income, paid leave, or health insurance.
What industries have been affected the most by the rise of gig platforms?
Freelancing has become much easier with global online payment systems.
I think the government should tax gig workers at a lower rate.
aciklama: Oliver'ın "En büyük dezavantajı da bu zaten. Esnekliğin bedeli iş güvencesi ve sağlık haklarının (lack of job security and healthcare benefits) olmamasıdır" tespiti, Emma'nın güvencesizliği, düzenli gelirin, ücretli iznin ve sağlık sigortasının olmamasını eleştirdiği B seçeneğiyle tam olarak örtüşür.

soru_metni: Jack: Research shows that music therapy can significantly reduce physical pain levels in hospital patients. Clara: ______ Jack: It triggers the release of endorphins and diverts the patient's attention away from their discomfort.
secenekler: I always listen to soft classical music when I have a headache.
What is the neurological mechanism behind that pain reduction?
Many hospitals are now hiring professional harpists and pianists.
Is music therapy also effective for patients with severe dementia?
I find it hard to believe that sound can replace chemical painkillers.
aciklama: Jack boşluktan sonra müzik terapisinin vücuttaki acıyı nasıl azalttığına dair nörolojik süreci ("Endorfin salgılanmasını tetikler ve hastanın dikkatini rahatsızlıktan uzaklaştırır") açıklamaktadır. Clara'nın bu ağrı azaltımının arkasındaki nörolojik mekanizmayı sorduğu B seçeneği akışa mükemmel oturur.

soru_metni: Arthur: We must transition from our current 'linear economy' to a 'circular economy.' Diana: ______ Arthur: It's an economic model designed to eliminate waste by keeping products and materials in use through recycling and reuse.
secenekler: Many multinational corporations are heavily resisting this transition.
Can you explain what a circular economy actually entails?
Linear economy is based on the 'take-make-waste' industrial model.
How does recycling plastic contribute to reducing carbon emissions?
I think governments should penalize companies that do not recycle.
aciklama: Arthur'un boşluktan sonra "Bu, geri dönüşüm ve yeniden kullanım yoluyla ürün ve malzemeleri kullanımda tutarak israfı ortadan kaldırmak için tasarlanmış bir ekonomik modeldir" diyerek döngüsel ekonominin tanımını yapması, Diana'nın bu modelin (circular economy) ne anlama geldiğini sorduğu B seçeneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Robert: I'm concerned that AI writing assistants are making students lazy and harming their writing skills. Jessica: ______ Robert: I hope you are right. Otherwise, we will end up with a generation that cannot express thoughts on paper.
secenekler: Many universities are now using advanced software to detect AI-written papers.
But they can also be used as brainstorming tools to help them structure their ideas.
I always use AI to proofread and correct spelling mistakes in my emails.
Writing is a skill that can only be developed through years of daily practice.
I think students have always found ways to avoid doing their own homework.
aciklama: Robert'ın "Umarım haklısındır. Aksi takdirde, düşüncelerini kağıda dökemeyen bir nesille karşı karşıya kalacağız" şeklindeki temkinli/umutlu yanıtı, Jessica'nın yapay zeka araçlarının öğrencilere fikirlerini yapılandırmada bir beyin fırtınası aracı (brainstorming tools) olarak da yardımcı olabileceği yönündeki yapıcı ve olumlu B seçeneğini destekler. Üçüncü 50'lik pakete (101 - 150) devam etmeye hazır olduğunuzda bana bildirmeniz yeterlidir. 💬 Bir sonraki 50 soruya geçmek için tekrar "devam" yazabilirsiniz. devam Thoughts YDS İngilizce sınavı standartlarında, mobil uygulamanız için özel olarak tasarlanmış, kısa, özgün ve birbirini tekrarlamayan Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue Completion) konularının üçüncü 50 soruluk (101-150) paketi aşağıdadır: YDS İngilizce - Diyalog Tamamlama Soru Bankası (101 - 150)

soru_metni: Amy: I think that preserving historic buildings is much more important than building modern skyscrapers. Tom: ______ Amy: That's a valid point, but we shouldn't lose our physical connection to the past just for the sake of utility.
secenekler: Many historic buildings are actually quite dangerous to live in.
Yes, but modern high-rises are essential for housing dense urban populations.
I prefer the architectural style of the Renaissance period.
How much does it cost to maintain a centuries-old castle?
Traditional architecture is becoming very popular among young designers.
aciklama: Tom'un dikey mimarinin ve modern gökdelenlerin yoğun nüfuslu şehirler için bir gereklilik olduğunu (B seçeneği) belirtmesi gerekir. Amy'nin "That's a valid point, but..." (Bu haklı bir nokta, ancak...) diyerek fayda (utility) için geçmişle olan bağın koparılmaması gerektiğini savunması bu akışla mükemmel uyumludur.

soru_metni: David: I've decided to quit social media for a month as an experiment. Sarah: ______ David: Mostly to see if my focus and attention span improve without constant distractions.
secenekler: Which social media platform do you use the most?
I think a month is way too short to see any real changes.
What is the main objective you hope to achieve by doing this?
Social media companies make billions of dollars from advertising.
Do you think your friends will be angry if you don't reply?
aciklama: David boşluktan sonra "Mostly to see..." (Çoğunlukla ... görmek için) diyerek deneyi yapma amacını açıklamaktadır. Sarah'nın bu eylemle neyi başarmayı umduğunu (main objective) sorduğu C seçeneği diyalogu doğal bir biçimde tamamlar.

soru_metni: Olivia: I think video games can actually be highly educational for young children. Ethan: ______ Olivia: True, which is why parents must carefully select games that focus on problem-solving and strategy.
secenekler: I played a lot of video games when I was in high school.
Yes, but only if they are not purely violent or repetitive.
Modern gaming consoles are becoming extremely expensive.
Many children prefer playing outdoors rather than on a screen.
Game development is one of the fastest-growing industries today.
aciklama: Olivia'nın "True, which is why..." (Doğru, bu yüzden...) diyerek ebeveynlerin problem çözme ve strateji odaklı oyunları dikkatle seçmesi gerektiğini belirtmesi, Ethan'ın oyunların şiddet içerikli veya tekdüze olmaması gerektiği (B seçeneği) yönündeki şartına katıldığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Sophia: Urban green spaces are not just beautiful; they are crucial for mental health. Liam: ______ Sophia: Exactly. Walking among trees has been proven to significantly lower cortisol levels.
secenekler: I try to go for a run in the park at least once a week.
Yes, they provide a much-needed escape from constant city noise and stress.
Most local municipalities do not invest enough in public parks.
Do you think green roofs are as effective as ground-level parks?
Air pollution is a major problem in almost every modern megacity.
aciklama: Sophia'nın "Exactly" (Kesinlikle) diyerek ağaçlar arasında yürümenin stres hormonu kortizolü düşürdüğünü söylemesi, Liam'ın yeşil alanların şehir gürültüsü ve stresinden kaçış sağladığını (B seçeneği) belirttiği tespitiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Emma: I find it really difficult to wake up early in the morning, even with alarms. Lucas: ______ Emma: I usually stay up late scrolling through news, which is probably the main issue.
secenekler: What time do you usually go to bed the night before?
Early risers are generally more productive throughout the day.
Have you tried using a louder alarm clock or an app?
I always drink a double espresso as soon as I wake up.
You should try exercising in the evening to tire yourself out.
aciklama: Emma'nın geceleri uyanık kalıp telefona baktığını ve bunun temel sorun olduğunu belirtmesi, Lucas'ın ona bir önceki gece genellikle saat kaçta yattığını sorduğu A seçeneğindeki sorusuna doğrudan bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Zoe: Transitioning to renewable energy is the only way to stop global warming. Ryan: Yes, but we must also ensure that oil-dependent economies are not left behind. Zoe: ______ Ryan: Exactly. A fair transition is necessary to prevent global economic crises.
secenekler: Renewable energy technology is becoming much cheaper now.
Yes, we need to provide them with financial and technological support to adapt.
Oil companies have been lobbying against solar energy for decades.
I don't think fossil fuels will ever completely disappear.
Many countries in Europe are leading the way in wind power.
aciklama: Ryan'ın en sonda "A fair transition..." (Adil bir geçiş...) diyerek ekonomik krizleri önlemenin önemini onaylaması, Zoe'nin boşlukta petrol bağımlısı ülkelere uyum sağlamaları için finansal ve teknolojik destek verilmesi gerektiğini (B seçeneği) önerdiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Leo: I think drone delivery services will revolutionize e-commerce in a few years. Maya: ______ Leo: That's true, which is why regulations must be established to keep them away from airports.
secenekler: How much weight can a commercial delivery drone actually carry?
But they present serious privacy and airspace safety concerns.
Online shopping has become more popular than physical retail.
Drones are already being used for search and rescue operations.
I prefer getting my packages delivered by traditional couriers.
aciklama: Leo'nun boşluktan sonra "Bu doğru, bu yüzden havalimanlarından uzak tutulmaları için düzenlemeler yapılmalı" demesi, Maya'nın drone'ların yaratacağı hava sahası güvenliği ve mahremiyet endişelerine (B seçeneği) değindiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Lily: Traditional classroom testing often measures memorization rather than actual intelligence. James: ______ Lily: Exactly. It doesn't show how well a student can solve real-world problems.
secenekler: I scored ninety-five on my last mathematics exam.
I agree. It mostly tests the ability to recall facts under pressure.
Traditional schools are being replaced by online academies.
Do you think multiple-choice tests are fairer than essay exams?
Many students experience severe test anxiety before big exams.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Exactly" diyerek bu durumun gerçek dünya sorunlarını çözme becerisini ölçmediğini eklemesi, James'in geleneksel sınavların sadece baskı altında bilgiyi hatırlama becerisini (B seçeneğindeki recall facts) ölçtüğünü belirten tespitiyle tam uyumludur.

soru_metni: Anna: I've started practicing 'mindful eating' to improve my relationship with food. David: ______ Anna: It means eating slowly and without distractions like TV, focusing on tastes and textures.
secenekler: I think dieting is the only way to lose weight permanently.
What does that concept actually involve in daily life?
Where did you hear about this new wellness trend?
I always watch my favorite show while having dinner.
Is it really healthier than a standard low-carb diet?
aciklama: Anna boşluktan sonra kavramın günlük hayattaki uygulamasını ("Televizyon gibi dikkat dağıtıcılar olmadan, tat ve dokulara odaklanarak yavaş yemek") açıklamaktadır. David'in bu kavramın tam olarak neyi içerdiğini sorduğu B seçeneği bu açıklamayı başlatan sorudur.

soru_metni: Chloe: Vertical farming uses up to ninety percent less water than traditional agriculture. Daniel: ______ Chloe: Yes, because the water is constantly recycled within a closed-loop system.
secenekler: Vertical farms are usually built inside urban areas.
Is that high efficiency due to the absence of soil?
That's a massive saving. How do they manage to conserve so much?
I believe organic farming is still better for the ecosystem.
How much electricity do those artificial LED lights consume?
aciklama: Chloe'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, çünkü su sürekli kapalı devre bir sistem içinde geri dönüştürülüyor" şeklindeki teknik açıklaması, Daniel'ın bu su tasarrufunun nasıl sağlandığını şaşkınlıkla sorduğu C seçeneğiyle memnuniyet verici şekilde bağlanır.

soru_metni: Victor: I think learning to code should be a mandatory subject in primary schools. Rachel: ______ Victor: Not to make everyone programmers, but to teach them systematic logic and problem-solving.
secenekler: Which programming languages are the most suitable for young kids?
But isn't it too early to push children into specialized career paths?
Coding has become a highly paid skill in the job market today.
I think children should spend more time learning history and art.
Most primary school teachers do not know how to write code.
aciklama: Victor'ın "Herkesi programcı yapmak için değil, onlara sistematik mantık ve sorun çözmeyi öğretmek için" açıklaması, Rachel'ın çocukları çok erken yaşta özel meslek yollarına (career paths) itmenin erken olup olmadığını sorguladığı B seçeneğine doğrudan bir cevaptır.

soru_metni: Paul: I find that listening to instrumental music helps me focus while writing reports. Diana: ______ Paul: Exactly. Vocals tend to distract me because my brain tries to follow the lyrics.
secenekler: I prefer listening to heavy metal when I am working out.
Yes, because songs with lyrics can interfere with your internal thoughts.
Classic classical music has been shown to boost IQ scores.
Do you use headphones or listen to it through speakers?
I cannot work in absolute silence; it makes me feel uneasy.
aciklama: Paul'ün "Aynen öyle. Şarkı sözleri (vocals) dikkatimi dağıtıyor çünkü beynim sözleri takip etmeye çalışıyor" açıklaması, Diana'nın sözlü şarkıların insanın içsel düşünceleriyle çelişebileceğini/bölüşebileceğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki tespiti doğrular.

soru_metni: Brian: Electric scooters have made short urban commutes incredibly convenient. Leo: Yes, but they are often left randomly on sidewalks, blocking pedestrians. Brian: ______ Leo: Definitely. Dedicated parking zones would easily solve that issue.
secenekler: I think they are too dangerous to be used in heavy traffic.
Well, they are still much cleaner than driving a petrol car.
True, we need stricter rules about where they can be parked.
How much does it cost to rent one for fifteen minutes?
Most people don't wear helmets while riding those scooters.
aciklama: Leo'nun en sondaki "Kesinlikle. Özel park bölgeleri bu sorunu kolayca çözer" önerisi, Brian'ın boşlukta park kurallarının sıkılaştırılması gerektiğine dair (C seçeneği) yaptığı tespiti doğrudan destekler.

soru_metni: Amy: I scored quite low on the reading section of the English exam. Kevin: ______ Amy: Honestly, I struggled with the academic vocabulary and the dense scientific texts.
secenekler: You should practice writing essays to improve your overall score.
What do you think was the main difficulty you faced during the test?
Reading comprehension is the most important skill in language exams.
Did you have enough time to finish all the questions in that section?
I think the exam questions were much harder than last year's.
aciklama: Amy'nin boşluktan sonra "Dürüst olmak gerekirse, akademik kelimelerle ve yoğun bilimsel metinlerle mücadele ettim" demesi, Kevin'ın ona sınavda karşılaştığı temel zorluğun (main difficulty) ne olduğunu sorduğu B seçeneğini gerektirir.

soru_metni: John: Fast-food menus should be legally required to display the calorie counts of all items. Lisa: ______ John: Exactly. It forces consumers to make more conscious, informed decisions about their meals.
secenekler: Most fast-food restaurants already have that information online.
I don't think calories are the only measure of how healthy a food is.
That would be a great way to raise public awareness about nutrition.
Many people eat fast food simply because they cannot cook at home.
The government should place a higher tax on high-calorie meals instead.
aciklama: John'un "Aynen öyle. Tüketicileri öğünleri hakkında daha bilinçli ve bilgili kararlar almaya zorlar" tespiti, Lisa'nın bu uygulamanın beslenme bilincini (nutrition awareness) artırmada harika bir yol olacağını belirttiği C seçeneğiyle tam bir uyum içindedir.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I've noticed that I spend much more money when I pay with a credit card than with cash. George: ______ Evelyn: Exactly. The physical act of handing over cash makes the loss feel much more real.
secenekler: Credit cards offer great cash-back rewards if you use them wisely.
That's because digital transactions remove the immediate pain of paying.
I always keep my credit cards at home to avoid temptation.
How many credit cards do you currently have in your wallet?
Most local shops in this area do not accept cash payments anymore.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Kesinlikle. Nakit parayı fiziksel olarak verme eylemi kaybı çok daha gerçek hissettiriyor" tespiti, George'un dijital işlemlerin ödeme anındaki anlık acıyı/hissi ortadan kaldırdığını (pain of paying) belirttiği B seçeneğini onaylar.

soru_metni: Arthur: I think high schools should teach basic financial literacy, like budgeting and taxes. Clara: ______ Arthur: Absolutely. Knowing how to manage money is just as vital as algebra or history.
secenekler: Most math teachers are not qualified to teach personal finance.
Yes, these are essential life skills that every adult needs daily.
I didn't learn how to pay taxes until I started my first job.
Do you think students would find finance classes too boring?
Many schools are already reducing the hours of elective classes.
aciklama: Arthur'un boşluktan sonra "Kesinlikle. Para yönetimini bilmek cebir veya tarih kadar hayati" diyerek fikri desteklemesi, Clara'nın bu becerilerin her yetişkinin her gün ihtiyaç duyduğu temel yaşam becerileri (essential life skills) olduğunu belirttiği B seçeneğiyle uyumludur.

soru_metni: Lucas: I believe the rise of artificial intelligence will make human translators obsolete. Sophia: ______ Lucas: True, but for legal contracts or literary works, nuance and cultural context are irreplaceable.
secenekler: Translation software is already built into most modern smartphones.
But AI still struggles to understand subtle humor and local idioms.
Yes, because machine translation has become incredibly fast and accurate.
I am currently studying translation and interpreting at university.
Most companies prefer hiring human translators for important meetings.
aciklama: Lucas'ın boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak yasal sözleşmeler veya edebi eserler için nüans ve kültürel bağlam ikame edilemez" diyerek yapay zekanın sınırlılıklarına geçmesi, öncesinde Sophia'nın makine çevirisinin hızını ve doğruluğunu övdüğü ve yapay zekayı desteklediği C seçeneğini onayladığını (True, but...) gösterir.

soru_metni: Sarah: The transition to electric vehicles might not be as green as we think. Tom: ______ Sarah: Exactly. Mining those minerals causes severe environmental degradation in developing countries.
secenekler: Because electric cars still emit carbon dioxide while driving?
Yes, especially considering the lithium battery production and disposal process.
Many countries are planning to build more nuclear power plants.
How much does a replacement battery for an electric SUV cost?
I think hydrogen cars are a much better alternative to batteries.
aciklama: Sarah'nın "Aynen öyle. O madenleri çıkartmak gelişmekte olan ülkelerde ciddi çevre tahribatına yol açıyor" tespiti, Tom'un lityum pil üretimi ve bertarafı (lithium battery production and disposal) gibi elektrikli araçların arka planındaki çevre kirliliği sorunlarına değindiği B seçeneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Oliver: I find it hard to stick to my study schedule when studying at home. Emma: ______ Oliver: That's a great tip. The change of environment might prevent me from getting distracted.
secenekler: You should study in your bedroom with the door closed.
Have you tried studying at the local library or a quiet cafe instead?
I always study while listening to energetic pop music.
Maybe you should reward yourself with chocolate after each page.
Home environments are generally much cleaner than public spaces.
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Bu harika bir ipucu. Ortam değişikliği (change of environment) dikkatimin dağılmasını engelleyebilir" demesi, Emma'nın ona kütüphane veya sakin bir kafe gibi ev dışı alternatif çalışma yerleri önerdiği B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Jack: Most people don't realize how much of their personal data is collected by smart home devices. Clara: ______ Jack: They continuously monitor your habits, voices, and even daily routines to target ads.
secenekler: I always turn off my smart speaker when I am not using it.
In what ways do these devices actually gather and use our information?
Smart appliances make daily household chores much faster and easier.
Do you think the government should regulate the smart device market?
I use a password manager to protect all my online accounts.
aciklama: Jack'in boşluktan sonra cihazların reklam hedeflemesi yapmak için alışkanlıkları, sesleri ve günlük rutinleri sürekli izlediğini belirtmesi, Clara'nın bu cihazların bilgileri ne şekillerde topladığını ve kullandığını sorduğu B seçeneğini karşılar.

soru_metni: Nancy: High-stress jobs are highly correlated with sleep apnea and heart disease. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, chronic stress triggers the constant release of adrenaline, damaging blood vessels.
secenekler: I think physical exercise is the best way to reduce daily stress.
Is there a biological explanation for how stress affects the heart?
Many executives work over sixty hours a week under high pressure.
Do you think sleep quality is more important than sleep duration?
Most doctors recommend taking a long vacation once a year.
aciklama: Nancy'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, kronik stres adrenalin salınımını tetikler ve kan damarlarına zarar verir" şeklinde fizyolojik detaylar vermesi, George'un stresin kalbi nasıl etkilediğine dair biyolojik bir açıklama (biological explanation) sorduğu B seçeneğine doğrudan cevaptır.

soru_metni: Lily: I prefer shopping at physical local markets rather than buying groceries online. Sam: ______ Lily: True, but supporting local farmers and getting to pick the freshest produce is worth it.
secenekler: Online grocery delivery is much faster and saves a lot of time.
Local markets are usually much cheaper than large supermarkets.
I always buy my vegetables from the organic section of the store.
How often do you visit the local market in your neighborhood?
Most farmers now accept credit cards and mobile payments.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Doğru, ama yerel çiftçileri desteklemek ve en taze ürünü seçebilmek buna değer" savunması, Sam'in çevrimiçi alışverişin zaman kazandıran pratikliğini ve hızını (B seçeneğindeki online grocery delivery) öne çıkardığı A seçeneğine verilmiş anlamlı bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: David: The rise of fast-fashion has led to a dramatic increase in global textile waste. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. Most synthetic fabrics take hundreds of years to decompose in landfills.
secenekler: Natural fibers like cotton are much easier to recycle than polyester.
Yes, because people buy cheap clothes and discard them after a few wears.
Many fashion brands are trying to use organic dyes in their products.
I always donate my old clothes to local charities or shelters.
Fast-fashion companies provide employment to millions in developing countries.
aciklama: David'in "Kesinlikle. Çoğu sentetik kumaşın çöplüklerde çürümesi yüzlerce yıl alıyor" tespiti, Sarah'nın insanların ucuz kıyafetler alıp birkaç giyimden sonra çöpe attığına (B seçeneği) yönelik yaptığı tespitle tam uyumludur.

soru_metni: Paul: I think the government should ban cars from city centers to reduce air pollution. Laura: ______ Paul: True, but they could invest more in expanding public transit and building bike lanes.
secenekler: Many European cities have already implemented partial car bans.
But how would residents and shopkeepers transport heavy goods then?
I think electric cars are already solving the city pollution problem.
The cost of maintaining public buses is very high for taxpayers.
Walking is much healthier than driving for daily short distances.
aciklama: Paul'ün boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ama toplu taşımayı genişletmeye ve bisiklet yolları yapmaya daha fazla yatırım yapabilirler" diyerek pratik bir çözüm sunması, Laura'nın araç yasağının nakliye ve ağır eşya taşımadaki lojistik zorluğunu (B seçeneğindeki transport heavy goods) dile getirdiği çekincesine cevaptır.

soru_metni: Kevin: I think artificial intelligence will soon be able to write bestselling novels. Rachel: ______ Kevin: I understand your skepticism, but AI can analyze thousands of plot structures to create a perfect formula.
secenekler: Writing a novel requires a lot of discipline and daily dedication.
I disagree; AI lacks the genuine human emotion and life experience needed for art.
Many publishers are already using AI to proofread manuscript submissions.
Which AI writing models are you currently experimenting with?
Most bestselling books nowadays rely on predictable cliches anyway.
aciklama: Kevin'ın "Şüpheciliğini (skepticism) anlıyorum, ancak yapay zeka mükemmel formülü oluşturmak için binlerce olay örgüsünü analiz edebilir" savunması, Rachel'ın sanat için yapay zekanın gerçek insani duygudan ve yaşam deneyiminden yoksun olduğunu (B seçeneği) söyleyerek karşı çıktığı argümana yöneliktir.

soru_metni: Lily: I've read that sound healing therapy is gaining scientific credibility for anxiety. Sam: ______ Lily: Yes, the specific frequencies help slow down brain waves and induce deep relaxation.
secenekler: I always listen to heavy metal when I feel stressed at work.
Is there actual evidence showing how sound waves affect our neurology?
Many hospitals are now using acoustic therapy in their recovery rooms.
I prefer traditional therapy methods like counseling over sound waves.
Sound frequencies can also be used to destroy kidney stones non-invasively.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Evet, belirli frekanslar beyin dalgalarını yavaşlatmaya ve derin gevşeme sağlamaya yardımcı olur" açıklaması, Sam'in ses dalgalarının nörolojimizi nasıl etkilediğine dair somut kanıtları (actual evidence) sorguladığı B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Alice: Remote work allows people to live in cheaper rural areas instead of expensive cities. Bob: ______ Alice: That's a critical challenge, but governments are expanding broadband fiber networks rapidly.
secenekler: I would love to buy a quiet house in a small mountain village.
But many rural areas still lack high-speed, reliable internet connection.
Rural life is much healthier due to lower noise and air pollution.
Most companies require their remote workers to live in the same country.
How do coworking spaces operate in small countryside towns?
aciklama: Alice'in "Bu kritik bir zorluk, ancak hükümetler geniş bant fiber ağları hızla yaygınlaştırıyor" açıklaması, Bob'un kırsal kesimdeki yüksek hızlı ve güvenilir internet erişimi eksikliğini (B seçeneğindeki lack high-speed reliable internet) bir dezavantaj olarak öne sürdüğünü doğrular.

soru_metni: James: Do you believe that space tourism will become affordable for ordinary citizens? Emily: ______ James: I agree. Mass production of reusable rockets will eventually drive the prices down.
secenekler: Space travel is still too dangerous due to cosmic radiation.
Yes, but only when aerospace companies manage to scale up their flights.
I don't think ordinary citizens are interested in going to space.
The government should ban private space exploration companies.
How long does a typical suborbital flight actually last?
aciklama: James'in boşluktan sonra "Katılıyorum. Yeniden kullanılabilir roketlerin seri üretimi en nihayetinde fiyatları aşağı çekecektir" tespiti, Emily'nin havacılık şirketlerinin uçuşları ölçeklendirmesi (scale up their flights) durumunda fiyatların düşebileceğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki olumlu ve yapıcı tespitiyle uyumludur.

soru_metni: Nancy: Practicing daily gratitude can significantly rewire the brain toward positivity. George: ______ Nancy: Simple things, like writing down three things you are thankful for every evening.
secenekler: I don't think happiness can be achieved through mental exercises.
What are some practical ways to integrate gratitude into a busy routine?
I am currently reading a book about cognitive behavioral therapy.
Gratitude is a core concept in many ancient philosophical systems.
Do you feel happier since you started doing this exercise?
aciklama: Nancy boşluktan hemen sonra "Akşamları şükran duyduğun üç şeyi yazmak gibi basit şeyler" diyerek somut yöntemler vermektedir. George'un bunu yoğun bir rutine entegre etmenin pratik yollarını (practical ways) sorduğu B seçeneği bu açıklamaya zemin hazırlar.

soru_metni: Clara: I think classical literature is becoming less relevant to modern high schoolers. Alex: ______ Clara: True. Adapting those universal stories to modern settings makes them much more accessible.
secenekler: Shakespeare's plays are still taught in almost every English-speaking country.
But they still contain universal human themes that can be made engaging with the right teaching methods.
Modern novels are much easier to read because of their simplified language.
How many classical books did you read when you were in high school?
Most students prefer watching the movie adaptation instead of reading.
aciklama: Clara'nın "Doğru. O evrensel hikayeleri modern kurgulara uyarlamak onları çok daha erişilebilir kılıyor" savunması, Alex'in klasik eserlerin doğru öğretim yöntemleriyle ilgi çekici hale getirilebilecek evrensel temalar (universal human themes) barındırdığını belirttiği B seçeneğini onaylar.

soru_metni: Michael: The restoration of urban wetlands can prevent severe flooding in coastal cities. Sarah: ______ Michael: Exactly. They act like giant natural sponges that absorb excess rainwater safely.
secenekler: Coastal cities are becoming much more crowded due to tourism.
How do wetlands actually manage to control massive amounts of water?
I think concrete dikes and dams are more reliable than natural solutions.
Wetland restoration projects require billions of dollars in public funding.
Many rare bird species rely on urban wetlands for nesting.
aciklama: Michael boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle. Fazla yağmur suyunu güvenle emen devasa doğal süngerler gibi davranırlar" diyerek su kontrol mekanizmasını açıklamaktadır. Sarah'nın sulak alanların suyu nasıl kontrol ettiğini sorduğu B seçeneği bu fiziki açıklamayı mükemmel tamamlar.

soru_metni: Victor: I think learning a foreign language is the best way to delay cognitive decline in old age. Rachel: ______ Victor: Because it forces the brain to constantly switch between different structural systems, strengthening neural plasticity.
secenekler: Bilingual children generally perform better in standard academic tests.
What is the neurological mechanism that makes language learning so beneficial?
I am currently trying to learn Japanese through an online course.
Is it easier to learn a language as a child or as an adult?
Most elderly people do not have the patience to study complex grammar.
aciklama: Victor'ın boşluktan sonra "Çünkü beyni sürekli farklı yapısal sistemler arasında geçiş yapmaya zorlar, nöral plastisiteyi güçlendirir" açıklaması, Rachel'ın bu faydanın arkasındaki nörolojik mekanizmayı (neurological mechanism) sorduğu B seçeneğini doğrudan yanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paul: Rooftop solar panels should be mandatory on all newly constructed apartment buildings. Diana: ______ Paul: I understand that, but the long-term energy savings would easily offset those initial expenses.
secenekler: Solar panels are becoming much more efficient even in cold climates.
But wouldn't that significantly increase the initial cost of building a home?
I think nuclear energy is still a more stable source of electricity.
Many residents are complaining about the visual impact of solar panels.
How much electrical energy can a single rooftop panel produce daily?
aciklama: Paul'ün "Bunu anlıyorum, ancak uzun vadeli enerji tasarrufu bu ilk masrafları kolayca dengeler" açıklaması, Diana'nın zorunluluğun konut inşaatının başlangıç maliyetini (initial cost) artıracağına dair getirdiği B seçeneğindeki haklı finansal endişeye cevap niteliğindedir.

soru_metni: Brian: The extreme preservation of historical artifacts in museums keeps them isolated from the public. Leo: ______ Brian: Exactly! Interactive virtual reality tours would allow people to examine them closely from home.
secenekler: Most museums are funded by government grants and ticket sales.
That's why we need to leverage digital technology to make them more accessible.
I think touch screens in museums are highly distracting for children.
Artifacts are too fragile to be handled by ordinary visitors without gloves.
Historical objects should only be studied by professional archaeologists.
aciklama: Brian'ın boşluktan sonra sanal gerçeklik turlarının (VR tours) nesnelerin evden yakından incelenmesini sağlayacağına değinmesi, Leo'nun müzeleri daha erişilebilir kılmak için dijital teknolojiden (digital technology) faydalanmamız gerektiğini belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Amy: I think standard IQ tests fail to capture creative and emotional intelligence. Kevin: ______ Amy: That's a fair point. A structured analytical test is much easier to grade objectively on a global scale.
secenekler: Yes, IQ tests mostly measure mathematical and logical reasoning.
But they are still the most standardized and reliable way to measure general cognitive ability.
I scored very high on the spatial reasoning section of the test.
Do you think emotional intelligence can be improved through training?
Many employers are now using personality tests instead of IQ tests.
aciklama: Amy'nin "Bu adil bir nokta. Yapılandırılmış analitik bir testi küresel ölçekte objektif olarak puanlamak çok daha kolay" yanıtı, Kevin'ın IQ testlerinin eksiklerine rağmen hala bilişsel yeteneği ölçen en standart ve güvenilir yol (standardized and reliable way) olduğunu savunduğu B seçeneğindeki görüşünü kabul ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: John: The rise of ride-sharing apps was supposed to reduce traffic congestion, but the opposite happened. Lisa: ______ John: Studies show they attract people who would otherwise use public transport, adding more cars to the road.
secenekler: Ride-sharing is usually much cheaper than taking a traditional taxi.
Why do you think ride-sharing has actually made urban traffic worse?
Most drivers work for multiple ride-sharing platforms at the same time.
The city council should impose a congestion tax on all private vehicles.
I always use public buses because they have dedicated lanes.
aciklama: John boşluktan sonra "Araştırmalar, toplu taşıma kullanacak insanları kendine çektiğini ve yola daha fazla araç eklediğini gösteriyor" diyerek trafiğin neden kötüleştiğini açıklamaktadır. Lisa'nın bu durumun neden trafiği daha da kötüleştirdiğini sorduğu B seçeneği akışa tam oturur.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I believe that reading physical fiction books enhances empathy more than watching movies. George: ______ Evelyn: True. Because reading forces you to imagine the characters' inner thoughts and emotions yourself.
secenekler: Movies are much faster at delivering complex stories to a large audience.
Yes, because physical books don't have visual distractions like special effects.
But both mediums can present highly emotional and complex narratives.
Do you prefer reading classic novels or modern psychological thrillers?
I think empathy is a trait that is genetically determined at birth.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Doğru. Çünkü okumak seni karakterlerin iç dünyasını ve duygularını kendin hayal etmeye zorluyor" açıklaması, George'un her iki mecranın da (hem kitapların hem de filmlerin) son derece duygusal ve karmaşık anlatılar sunabileceğini (C seçeneği) belirterek getirdiği "But..." (Ancak...) karşılaştırmasına verilmiş tamamlayıcı bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Arthur: Micro-plastics are now being detected in remote rain and snow far away from industrial zones. Clara: ______ Arthur: Wind currents carry lightweight plastic fibers high into the atmosphere, distributing them globally.
secenekler: Most plastic pollution in the oceans comes from major rivers.
How do they actually manage to travel such vast distances through the air?
We should stop using single-use plastic packaging immediately.
Are micro-plastics dangerous to human health when inhaled?
I always carry a canvas tote bag when I go to the supermarket.
aciklama: Arthur boşluktan sonra "Rüzgar akımları hafif plastik lifleri atmosferin üst katmanlarına taşır ve küresel olarak dağıtır" şeklinde taşınma mekanizmasını açıklamaktadır. Clara'nın bu plastiklerin havada bu kadar uzun mesafeleri nasıl katettiğini sorduğu B seçeneği diyalogu bağlar.

soru_metni: Lucas: I think high schools should replace traditional physical education with lifestyle health classes. Sophia: ______ Lucas: Exactly. Teaching them nutrition, sleep hygiene, and stress management is much more useful for their adult lives.
secenekler: I played soccer and basketball when I was in high school.
Yes, because playing sports is not the only way to stay healthy and fit.
Traditional gym classes are very popular among athletic students.
Do you think schools have enough budget to hire professional dietitians?
Lifestyle diseases like diabetes are rising rapidly among teenagers.
aciklama: Lucas'ın "Aynen öyle. Onlara beslenmeyi, uyku hijyenini ve stres yönetimini öğretmek yetişkinlik hayatlarında çok daha faydalıdır" tespiti, Sophia'nın sağlıklı kalmanın tek yolunun spor yapmak olmadığını (B seçeneği) belirterek spor derslerinin ötesine geçilmesi gerektiğini desteklediği tespitiyle örtüşür.

soru_metni: Sarah: I'm trying to practice 'digital minimalism' by keeping my smartphone screen grayscale. Tom: ______ Sarah: It removes the bright, colorful visual rewards that trigger dopamine loops, making the phone boring.
secenekler: I think modern smartphones have incredibly beautiful OLED displays.
How does changing the screen color actually reduce your phone usage?
I always use a blue light filter in the evening to protect my eyes.
Digital minimalism is just a passing trend for tech enthusiasts.
Which mobile applications do you spend the most time on daily?
aciklama: Sarah boşluktan sonra "Telefonun ekranını gri tonlamalı yapmanın, dopamin döngülerini tetikleyen parlak ve renkli görsel ödülleri ortadan kaldırdığını ve telefonu sıkıcı hale getirdiğini" açıklamaktadır. Tom'un ekran rengini değiştirmenin telefon kullanımını nasıl azalttığını sorduğu B seçeneği bu açıklamayı doğrudan tetikler.

soru_metni: Oliver: The preservation of native crop varieties is essential for global food security. Emma: ______ Oliver: Exactly. They contain diverse genetic traits that can resist new plant diseases or extreme droughts.
secenekler: Genetically modified crops are much easier and cheaper to grow.
Yes, because a single disease could wipe out monoculture farming entirely.
Most modern supermarkets only sell a few commercial varieties of apples.
Organic farming requires more manual labor and natural fertilizers.
How do scientists store endangered seeds for future generations?
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Aynen öyle. Yeni bitki hastalıklarına veya aşırı kuraklıklara direnebilecek çeşitli genetik özellikler içerirler" açıklaması, Emma'nın tek tip tarımın (monoculture) tek bir hastalıkla tamamen yok olabileceğini ve bu yüzden yerli türlerin korunması gerektiğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki haklı uyarısını onaylar.

soru_metni: Jack: I think virtual reality will eventually replace physical business travel completely. Clara: ______ Jack: True, but for casual project updates and routine check-ins, VR is much more efficient.
secenekler: High-quality VR headsets are still too heavy to wear for hours.
Yes, because companies are trying to reduce their travel expenses anyway.
But building deep trust with clients often requires physical, face-to-face meetings.
How much does a typical international flight cost for a business executive?
Many hotels are opening dedicated coworking spaces for travelers.
aciklama: Jack'in boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak sıradan proje güncellemeleri ve rutin kontroller için VR çok daha verimlidir" diyerek esnemesi, Clara'nın derin güven ilişkisi kurmak için yüz yüze fiziksel toplantıların (face-to-face meetings) şart olduğunu belirttiği C seçeneğindeki eleştirisine hak verdiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Nancy: I started using a blue light filter on all my digital screens after sunset. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, my eyes feel much less strained, and I find myself falling asleep more easily.
secenekler: Blue light filters make the screen look too orange and warm.
Have you noticed any real improvement in your sleep or eye comfort?
I always turn off my computer at least two hours before going to bed.
Blue light from screens has been linked to macular degeneration.
Most modern laptops have a built-in night mode feature.
aciklama: Nancy'nin "Evet, gözlerimde çok daha az yorgunluk hissediyorum ve daha kolay uykuya daldığımı fark ediyorum" yanıtı, George'un bu filtrenin uyku veya göz konforunda gerçek bir iyileşme (real improvement) sağlayıp sağlamadığını merak ettiği B seçeneğindeki sorusunun cevabıdır.

soru_metni: David: I believe the gig economy exploitation can only be solved through federal labor laws. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. If companies are not legally forced to provide benefits, they will continue to avoid them.
secenekler: Many freelancers actually enjoy the flexibility of gig work models.
Yes, because voluntary corporate guidelines are rarely effective for worker rights.
The government should reduce income taxes for independent freelancers.
How do ride-sharing drivers calculate their net earnings after fuel?
Most labor unions are already protesting against gig economy platforms.
aciklama: David'in "Aynen öyle. Şirketler yasal olarak yan hakları sağlamaya zorlanmazlarsa, bundan kaçınmaya devam edecekler" açıklaması, Sarah'nın şirketlerin gönüllü rehber ilkelerinin işçi hakları için nadiren etkili olduğunu (B seçeneğindeki voluntary corporate guidelines) belirttiği tespitiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Paul: Noise-canceling headphones are a lifesaver for open-plan office workers. Laura: ______ Paul: True, but without them, the constant background chatter makes deep work impossible.
secenekler: I prefer working in absolute silence inside a private office cubicle.
Yes, but they can isolate you too much, making casual team collaboration harder.
Noise-canceling technology has become incredibly cheap to purchase lately.
Most open-plan offices are designed to encourage transparency and trust.
How long does the battery of a typical noise-canceling headset last?
aciklama: Paul'ün boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak onlar olmadan sürekli arka plan gürültüsü derinlemesine çalışmayı (deep work) imkansız hale getiriyor" demesi, Laura'nın bu kulaklıkların insanı ekipten aşırı izole edebileceğini ve ekip çalışmasını zorlaştırabileceğini (B seçeneğindeki isolate you too much) belirttiği eleştirisine karşı bir savunmadır.

soru_metni: Kevin: Standardized testing has completely narrowed down the curriculum in high schools. Rachel: ______ Kevin: Exactly. Teachers end up 'teaching to the test' instead of fostering creativity and critical thinking.
secenekler: Standardized exams are the only objective way to evaluate students globally.
Yes, subjects that are not tested, like arts and music, are often neglected.
I scored ninety-eight points on the national science exam myself.
Do you think essay-based exams are fairer than multiple-choice tests?
Many schools are investing heavily in modern STEM laboratories now.
aciklama: Kevin'ın "Aynen öyle. Öğretmenler yaratıcılığı ve eleştirel düşünmeyi teşvik etmek yerine sadece 'sınava yönelik eğitim' veriyorlar" açıklaması, Rachel'ın sınavda sorulmayan sanat ve müzik gibi derslerin ihmal edildiğini (B seçeneği) belirten tespitini onaylar ve somutlaştırır.

soru_metni: Lily: I find it fascinating how bioluminescent organisms can produce light without heat. Sam: ______ Lily: Yes, they use a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase enzymes.
secenekler: Most deep-sea fish are bioluminescent to attract prey in the dark.
Is there a specific biochemical process behind this cold light generation?
I saw a documentary about bioluminescent mushrooms in a Japanese forest.
Bioluminescence is also being researched for sustainable street lighting.
How do fireflies manage to flash their lights in perfect synchronization?
aciklama: Lily'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, lusiferin ve lusiferaz enzimlerini içeren kimyasal bir reaksiyon kullanırlar" diyerek biyokimyasal süreci açıklaması, Sam'in bu soğuk ışık üretiminin (cold light generation) arkasında özel bir biyokimyasal süreç (specific biochemical process) olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Alice: Implementing congestion pricing in downtown areas is the best way to ease traffic. Bob: ______ Alice: That's a valid concern, which is why the revenue should be used to make public transit cheaper.
secenekler: Congestion taxes have been highly successful in London and Singapore.
But wouldn't that place an unfair financial burden on low-income commuters?
I prefer driving my car even if I have to pay high parking fees.
How do they actually monitor which cars enter the pricing zone?
Most people would support the tax if it reduced air pollution levels.
aciklama: Alice'in "Bu haklı bir endişe, bu yüzden elde edilen gelir toplu taşımayı daha ucuz hale getirmek için kullanılmalıdır" açıklaması, Bob'un sıkışıklık vergisinin düşük gelirli çalışanlar üzerinde adaletsiz bir finansal yük (financial burden on low-income commuters) yaratacağına dair getirdiği B seçeneğindeki sosyo-ekonomik eleştirisine bir çözümdür.

soru_metni: James: I think the constant pursuit of productivity is actually making us less creative. Emily: ______ James: Exactly. True creativity requires idle time and boredom for the mind to wander freely.
secenekler: Many companies are trying to implement a four-day workweek lately.
Yes, when every hour is optimized, there is no space for random experimentation.
I always use a time-tracking app to organize my daily task list.
Do you think creative thinking is a skill that can be taught in schools?
Most artists are highly disciplined and work on a very strict schedule.
aciklama: James'in "Aynen öyle. Gerçek yaratıcılık, zihnin serbestçe gezinmesi için boş zaman ve can sıkıntısı gerektirir" tespiti, Emily'nin her saatin optimize edilmesinin rastgele deneyler yapmaya (random experimentation) yer bırakmadığını belirttiği B seçeneğini tam olarak doğrular. Dördüncü 50'lik pakete (151 - 200) devam etmeye hazır olduğunuzda bana bildirmeniz yeterlidir. 💬 Bir sonraki 50 soruya geçmek için tekrar "devam" yazabilirsiniz. devam Thoughts YDS İngilizce sınavı standartlarında, mobil uygulamanız için özel olarak tasarlanmış, kısa, özgün ve birbirini tekrarlamayan Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue Completion) konularının dördüncü 50 soruluk (151-200) paketi aşağıdadır: YDS İngilizce - Diyalog Tamamlama Soru Bankası (151 - 200)

soru_metni: Amy: I've noticed that many people are shifting from large supermarkets to small local shops. Tom: ______ Amy: Exactly. Plus, it supports the local economy and reduces our carbon footprint.
secenekler: I think large supermarkets are always cheaper and have more variety.
Yes, because small shops often offer fresher products and a friendlier experience.
I always buy my groceries online because it saves a lot of time.
Small shops are usually located too far from residential areas.
Supermarkets are planning to ban single-use plastics very soon.
aciklama: Tom'un küçük yerel dükkanların daha taze ürün ve daha samimi bir deneyim sunduğuna (B seçeneği) dair tespiti gerekir. Amy'nin "Exactly" (Aynen öyle) diyerek yerel ekonomiye destek ve karbon ayak izini azaltma gibi diğer avantajları eklemesi bu akışı kusursuz tamamlar.

soru_metni: David: I believe that learning to play a strategy game like chess should be taught in schools. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. It teaches children to think ahead and consider the consequences of their actions.
secenekler: Chess tournaments are very popular among high school students.
Yes, because it helps develop critical thinking and long-term planning skills.
I think physical education is more important than board games.
How much does a high-quality chess set actually cost nowadays?
Most children prefer playing video games over traditional board games.
aciklama: David'in boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle. Çocuklara ileriyi düşünmeyi ve eylemlerinin sonuçlarını değerlendirmeyi öğretir" demesi, Sarah'nın satranç gibi oyunların eleştirel düşünme ve uzun vadeli planlama becerilerini (B seçeneği) geliştirdiğini belirttiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Olivia: The concept of a 'smart city' is becoming a reality much faster than expected. Ethan: ______ Olivia: True, but integrating technology into public transit and energy grids makes daily life much smoother.
secenekler: I prefer living in a small, quiet countryside town instead.
But are we ready for the potential cybersecurity and privacy risks it brings?
Smart cities require billions of dollars in infrastructure investments.
Many citizens do not know how to use smart public transit apps.
Solar-powered streetlights are already being used in our neighborhood.
aciklama: Olivia'nın "True, but..." (Doğru, ama...) diyerek teknolojinin günlük hayatı kolaylaştırma avantajına geçmesi, Ethan'ın siber güvenlik ve gizlilik risklerine (B seçeneği) yönelik getirdiği haklı çekinceyi kabul ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Sophia: I find that keeping a physical journal is much more therapeutic than blogging online. Liam: ______ Sophia: Exactly. There's no pressure of an audience, so you can be completely honest with yourself.
secenekler: Blogging allows you to share your thoughts with a global audience easily.
Yes, because writing by hand in a private book feels deeply personal.
I always use a digital calendar to organize my daily task list.
Writing essays was my least favorite subject when I was in school.
Most people don't have the patience to write every single day.
aciklama: Sophia'nın "Aynen öyle. Okuyucu baskısı olmadığı için kendinize karşı tamamen dürüst olabilirsiniz" yanıtı, Liam'ın fiziksel ve özel bir deftere yazmanın derin kişisel hissettirdiğini (B seçeneği) belirten yorumuyla birebir örtüşür.

soru_metni: Emma: I think corporate sponsorships are slowly destroying the authentic spirit of sports. Lucas: ______ Emma: That's a fair point. Without that massive funding, many minority sports wouldn't survive at all.
secenekler: Most professional athletes earn millions of dollars from brand deals.
But those sponsorships provide the essential financial support needed for clubs and facilities.
I always buy the official jersey of my favorite basketball team.
Sport is the most effective tool to promote international peace and unity.
The government should subsidize all major sports leagues instead.
aciklama: Emma'nın boşluktan sonra "Bu adil bir nokta. O büyük finansman olmasaydı, many minority sports (birçok küçük spor dalı) ayakta kalamazdı" açıklaması, Lucas'ın sponsorlukların kulüpler ve tesisler için hayati finansal destek (B seçeneği) sağladığını belirttiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Zoe: The rise of fast-food delivery apps has significantly changed our cooking habits. Ryan: ______ Zoe: True. It is so easy to order that many people are forgetting how to cook simple meals.
secenekler: Fast food is highly linked to several health problems like heart disease.
Yes, it has made ordering takeout much more convenient than preparing dinner.
I always tip the delivery driver when my food arrives on time.
Most restaurants on those apps are actually small family businesses.
Cooking at home is still much cheaper than ordering takeout online.
aciklama: Zoe'nin "Doğru. Sipariş vermek o kadar kolay ki birçok insan basit yemekleri bile yapmayı unutuyor" tespiti, Ryan'ın uygulamanın dışarıdan sipariş vermeyi akşam yemeği hazırlamaktan çok daha pratik kıldığına (B seçeneği) dair yorumunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Leo: I think the government should subsidize public transit to make it free for everyone. Maya: ______ Leo: That's true, but the reduction in traffic congestion and air pollution would benefit all taxpayers.
secenekler: Public transit in our city is already very clean and reliable.
But how would the city afford the massive maintenance and salary costs then?
I always buy a monthly pass because it is cheaper than daily tickets.
Free transport might attract more tourists to our historic downtown area.
Many people prefer driving their private cars because they are faster.
aciklama: Leo'nun "Bu doğru, ancak trafik sıkışıklığı ve hava kirliliğindeki azalma tüm vergi mükelleflerine fayda sağlar" savunması, Maya'nın sistemin bilet geliri olmadan bakım ve personel maaşlarını (B seçeneği) nasıl karşılayacağına yönelik getirdiği mali endişeye bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Lily: I believe that regular exposure to nature is essential for children's cognitive development. James: ______ Lily: Exactly. It stimulates curiosity and creativity in a way that indoor activities cannot.
secenekler: Many families prefer spending their weekends in modern shopping malls.
Yes, playing outdoors forces them to interact with and understand the physical world.
I always take my children to the playground after school hours.
Nature documentaries are a great way to learn about rare wild animals.
Most urban parks are not safe enough for children to play unsupervised.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Aynen öyle. İç mekan aktivitelerinin yapamayacağı şekilde merak ve yaratıcılığı canlandırır" açıklaması, James'in dışarıda oynamanın çocukları fiziksel dünyayla etkileşime girmeye zorladığına (B seçeneği) yönelik tespitiyle tam bir uyum içindedir.

soru_metni: Anna: I've started using a smart watch to track my daily steps and heart rate. David: ______ Anna: Yes, it gives me a clear, visual picture of my physical activity, which keeps me motivated.
secenekler: Smart watches are getting more expensive with every new model.
Do you feel that having that real-time data has actually helped you stay active?
I always turn off my smart devices during my working hours.
Most smart watches have a very short battery life of just two days.
I prefer wearing classic mechanical watches because they look more elegant.
aciklama: Anna'nın "Evet, fiziksel aktivitemin net ve görsel bir resmini sunuyor, bu da beni motive ediyor" cevabı, David'in bu anlık verilere (real-time data) sahip olmanın aktif kalmaya gerçekten yardımcı olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Chloe: I think that standard school hours should start later in the morning for teenagers. Daniel: ______ Chloe: Yes, biology shows their circadian rhythms are shifted, making them naturally sleep and wake up later.
secenekler: Most teenagers spend too much time playing video games late at night.
Is there actual scientific evidence supporting that sleep pattern change?
I always woke up at six AM when I was in high school.
School districts are worried about how it would affect bus schedules.
A later start might give teachers more time to prepare their lessons.
aciklama: Chloe'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, biyoloji onların sirkadiyen ritimlerinin kaydığını, doğal olarak daha geç uyuyup uyandıklarını gösteriyor" şeklindeki bilimsel açıklaması, Daniel'ın bu durumla ilgili bilimsel kanıt (scientific evidence) olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Victor: I think local municipalities should ban the sale of bottled water in public buildings. Rachel: ______ Victor: Because it generates an immense amount of plastic waste that is rarely recycled properly.
secenekler: Tap water in our city is actually very clean and completely safe to drink.
What is the main reason behind your support for such a strict ban?
Bottled water companies are making massive profits from public installations.
How much does a typical bottle of mineral water cost at the cafeteria?
Most people already carry their own reusable water bottles nowadays.
aciklama: Victor'ın boşluktan sonra "Çünkü nadiren düzgün şekilde geri dönüştürülen muazzam miktarda plastik atık üretiyor" diyerek gerekçesini açıklaması, Rachel'ın bu yasağı desteklemesinin arkasındaki temel nedeni (main reason) sorduğu B seçeneğine doğrudan bir cevaptır.

soru_metni: Paul: Continuous notification pings on our phones are ruinous for our attention spans. Diana: ______ Paul: Exactly. We are constantly in a state of 'continuous partial attention,' never fully focusing.
secenekler: I always use a customized ringtone for my close family members.
Yes, they train our brains to expect a constant stream of tiny dopamine hits.
Most social media apps allow you to mute notifications permanently.
Smartphones are becoming much faster with advanced multi-tasking chips.
I think digital tools are essential for managing a modern business efficiently.
aciklama: Paul'ün "Kesinlikle. Sürekli olarak 'continuous partial attention' (kesintili kısmi dikkat) durumundayız, asla tam odaklanamıyoruz" açıklaması, Diana'nın bildirimlerin beynimizi sürekli küçük dopamin vuruşları (dopamine hits) beklemeye alıştırdığını belirttiği B seçeneğini onaylar.

soru_metni: Brian: The rise of e-books was predicted to destroy physical bookstores, but they are surviving. Leo: ______ Brian: Exactly. People still crave the sensory experience of browsing shelves and holding a book.
secenekler: E-books are much lighter and easier to carry during long-distance travels.
That's because physical stores have transformed into community hubs with cafes and events.
I always buy my books from online platforms because they offer discounts.
Most physical books are printed on recycled paper to protect the environment.
E-readers are becoming much cheaper and accessible for students now.
aciklama: Brian'ın "Aynen öyle. İnsanlar hala raflara göz atma ve bir kitabı tutma gibi duyusal deneyimleri arzuluyor" açıklaması, Leo'un fiziksel kitapçıların kafe ve etkinliklerle birer topluluk merkezine (community hubs) dönüştüğünü belirterek hayatta kalma sebeplerini açıkladığı B seçeneğiyle tam uyumludur.

soru_metni: Amy: I scored very low on the grammar section of the English proficiency exam. Kevin: ______ Amy: Mostly with the complex conditional sentences and inverted structures.
secenekler: You should spend more time reading academic articles to expand your vocabulary.
Which specific grammar structures or rules did you find the most confusing?
Grammar is the most boring part of learning a foreign language in my opinion.
Did you have enough time to review all your answers before submitting the test?
I scored a perfect ninety-five on the reading comprehension section myself.
aciklama: Amy'nin boşluktan sonra "Çoğunlukla karmaşık koşul cümleleri ve devrik yapılarla" diyerek spesifik konuları belirtmesi, Kevin'ın ona en kafa karıştırıcı bulduğu dil bilgisi yapılarını (specific grammar structures) sorduğu B seçeneğini gerektirir.

soru_metni: John: I think all public museums should be completely free to encourage cultural education. Lisa: ______ John: Exactly. The cost of a ticket shouldn't prevent anyone from accessing human heritage.
secenekler: Many museums are already free on the first Monday of every month.
Yes, access to art and history should be treated as a fundamental human right.
I prefer visiting art galleries because they are usually less crowded.
How would museums pay for the security and preservation of rare artifacts?
Most tourists are willing to pay high prices to see famous historical relics.
aciklama: John'un "Kesinlikle. Bilet maliyeti kimsenin insanlık mirasına erişmesini engellememeli" tespiti, Lisa'nın sanat ve tarihe erişimin temel bir insan hakkı (fundamental human right) olarak görülmesi gerektiğini belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrudan onaylar ve destekler.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I've noticed that I eat much faster when I am watching TV or scrolling on my phone. George: ______ Evelyn: Exactly. When your mind is occupied, you miss the body's internal fullness signals.
secenekler: I always try to cook healthy meals at home instead of ordering fast food.
That's because eating distractedly prevents you from being mindful of your intake.
TV commercials are filled with advertisements for delicious, high-calorie snacks.
How many meals do you typically eat throughout a busy working day?
I think watching a documentary is a great way to relax while having dinner.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Aynen öyle. Zihniniz meşgul olduğunda, vücudun içsel doyma sinyallerini kaçırıyorsunuz" tespiti, George'un dikkat dağıtıcı unsurlarla yemek yemenin aldığımız gıdanın farkında olmamızı engellediğini (mindful of your intake) belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Arthur: I think high schools should replace traditional geometry with practical statistics. Clara: ______ Arthur: Absolutely. Analyzing data and identifying fake statistics online is a crucial modern skill.
secenekler: Geometry is essential for students who want to study engineering at university.
Yes, because we live in a data-driven world where data literacy is vital daily.
I didn't learn how to calculate percentages until I started working in a bank.
Do you think high school students would find statistics classes too difficult?
Many schools are already investing in modern computer coding classes instead.
aciklama: Arthur'un boşluktan sonra "Kesinlikle. Verileri analiz etmek ve internetteki sahte istatistikleri belirlemek kritik bir modern beceridir" demesi, Clara'nın veri okuryazarlığının (data literacy) hayati olduğu veri odaklı bir dünyada yaşadığımızı belirttiği B seçeneğindeki tespitiyle örtüşür.

soru_metni: Lucas: I believe the integration of AI in diagnostic medicine will revolutionize healthcare. Sophia: ______ Lucas: True, but as an assistive tool, it can process data much faster than any human doctor.
secenekler: AI algorithms are already being used to analyze patient MRI scans globally.
But are we ready to trust a machine's decision over a doctor's empathy and experience?
Healthcare costs are rising rapidly due to advanced medical technologies.
Many medical students are choosing radiology as their primary specialty now.
I think lifestyle factors like diet and sleep are still the best medicine.
aciklama: Lucas'ın "Doğru, ancak yardımcı bir araç olarak, verileri her insan doktordan çok daha hızlı işleyebilir" diyerek esnemesi, Sophia'nın bir makinenin kararına bir doktorun empatisi ve deneyimi karşısında güvenip güvenemeyeceğimizi (B seçeneği) sorguladığı eleştirisine cevap niteliğindedir.

soru_metni: Sarah: Some scientists believe that organic farming is not actually sustainable globally. Tom: ______ Sarah: Exactly. It requires up to forty percent more land to produce the same yield as conventional farming.
secenekler: Organic food is much healthier because it is grown without chemical pesticides.
Yes, because its lower yields mean we would have to clear more forests for agriculture.
I always try to buy my vegetables from local farmers' markets on weekends.
Genetically modified crops are highly controversial in many European countries.
How much does a typical organic apple cost compared to a conventional one?
aciklama: Sarah'nın "Aynen öyle. Konvansiyonel tarımla aynı ürünü elde etmek için %40'a kadar daha fazla arazi gerektiriyor" tespiti, Tom'un düşük verimlilik nedeniyle tarım için daha fazla ormanlık alanı yok etmek zorunda kalacağımıza (B seçeneğindeki lower yields) dair sunduğu gerekçeyi doğrular.

soru_metni: Oliver: I find it incredibly difficult to stay focused when working in an open-plan office. Emma: ______ Oliver: That's a great suggestion. The quiet room might help me get through my deep work.
secenekler: Open-plan offices are designed to encourage casual collaboration among employees.
Have you tried booking one of the dedicated quiet booths for a few hours instead?
I always use noise-canceling headphones to block out the background noise.
Maybe you should ask your manager if you can work from home on Fridays.
Open offices are usually much brighter and have better natural lighting.
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Bu harika bir öneri. Sessiz oda (quiet room) derinlemesine çalışmamı tamamlamama yardımcı olabilir" demesi, Emma'nın ona birkaç saatliğine özel sessiz kabinleri (quiet booths) rezerve etmesini önerdiği B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Jack: Most people don't realize how much carbon is emitted by sending and storing emails. Clara: ______ Jack: Every single email stored in a cloud database requires electricity to power the giant data centers.
secenekler: I always delete my old promotional emails to free up cloud storage space.
How does a simple digital message actually generate physical carbon emissions?
Cloud computing is becoming much cheaper and accessible for small businesses.
Do you think companies should charge a tax for sending bulk emails?
Most modern data centers are now powered by renewable wind and solar energy.
aciklama: Jack'in boşluktan sonra "Bulut veri tabanında saklanan her bir e-posta, devasa veri merkezlerine güç sağlamak için elektrik gerektirir" diyerek mekanizmayı açıklaması, Clara'nın basit bir dijital mesajın fiziksel karbon emisyonunu nasıl ürettiğini (B seçeneği) sorduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Nancy: Sedentary lifestyles are strongly correlated with chronic back pain and poor posture. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, sitting for long hours weakens the core muscles that are meant to support the spine.
secenekler: I think swimming is the best physical exercise for overall back health.
Is there a physiological explanation for why sitting causes so much discomfort?
Many office chairs are specifically designed to be ergonomic for the spine.
Do you think standing desks are actually better than standard sitting ones?
Most physical therapists recommend stretching for ten minutes every morning.
aciklama: Nancy'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, uzun saatler oturmak omurgayı desteklemesi gereken merkez kaslarını zayıflatır" şeklindeki fizyolojik detaylar vermesi, George'un oturmanın neden bu kadar rahatsızlığa yol açtığına dair fizyolojik bir açıklama (physiological explanation) sorduğu B seçeneğine doğrudan cevaptır.

soru_metni: Lily: I prefer buying second-hand furniture rather than purchasing brand new items. Sam: ______ Lily: True, but restoring a quality vintage piece is half the fun, and it prevents waste.
secenekler: Brand new furniture usually comes with a warranty and free home delivery.
But isn't it hard to find pieces that are in good condition and don't need repairs?
I always visit antique shops when I am looking for unique home decor.
How much does a typical second-hand dining table cost in this city?
Most modern furniture is made of cheap particle board that doesn't last long.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Doğru, ancak kaliteli bir klasik parçayı restore etmek işin eğlenceli kısmıdır ve israfı önler" savunması, Sam'in iyi durumda olan ve tamir gerektirmeyen (B seçeneğindeki don't need repairs) parçalar bulmanın zor olup olmadığını sorguladığı şüpheci yaklaşımına tam bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: David: The rapid melting of glaciers is causing a significant rise in sea levels globally. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. It directly threatens coastal infrastructure and millions of homes in low-lying areas.
secenekler: Many arctic animal species like polar bears are losing their natural habitats.
Yes, and it also accelerates coastal erosion and saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers.
I think building giant concrete dikes is the only way to protect coastal cities.
How do scientists actually measure the thickness of arctic ice sheets remotely?
Glaciers have been expanding and retreating naturally for millions of years.
aciklama: David'in "Kesinlikle. Kıyı altyapısını ve alçak bölgelerdeki milyonlarca evi doğrudan tehdit ediyor" tespiti, Sarah'nın deniz seviyelerindeki yükselmenin kıyı erozyonunu ve tatlı su kaynaklarına tuzlu su karışmasını (B seçeneğindeki saltwater intrusion) hızlandırdığına dair ekolojik tespitiyle mükemmel bağlanır.

soru_metni: Paul: I think the government should ban plastic single-use bags in all grocery stores. Laura: ______ Paul: True, but paper bags also require massive amounts of water and energy to produce.
secenekler: Many supermarkets are already charging customers for plastic shopping bags.
But wouldn't replacing them with paper bags just shift the environmental burden?
I always bring my own reusable cotton tote bags when I go shopping.
How much does a biodegradable plastic bag actually cost to manufacture?
Plastic pollution in the oceans is threatening several endangered marine species.
aciklama: Paul'ün boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak kağıt torbalar da üretilmek için muazzam miktarda su ve enerji gerektirir" diyerek kağıt torba üretimine geçmesi, Laura'nın plastik torbaları kağıtla değiştirmenin çevre yükünü (environmental burden) başka bir yere kaydırıp kaydırmayacağını sorguladığı B seçeneğine doğrudan cevaptır.

soru_metni: Kevin: I think artificial intelligence will soon replace professional graphic designers. Rachel: ______ Kevin: I understand your skepticism, but AI can generate hundreds of high-quality logos in seconds.
secenekler: Modern graphic design software is becoming much easier for amateurs to use.
I disagree; AI lacks the unique human creativity, context, and artistic intuition.
Many advertising agencies are already using AI to brainstorm visual concepts.
Which AI image generation models do you use the most in your projects?
Most graphic designers rely on predictable templates and color palettes anyway.
aciklama: Kevin'ın "Şüpheciliğini (skepticism) anlıyorum, ancak yapay zeka saniyeler içinde yüzlerce kaliteli logo üretebilir" savunması, Rachel'ın sanat için yapay zekanın gerçek insani yaratıcılıktan, bağlamdan ve sanatsal sezgiden (B seçeneği) yoksun olduğunu söyleyerek karşı çıktığı argümana yöneliktir.

soru_metni: Lily: I've read that forest bathing is gaining scientific support for reducing mental fatigue. Sam: ______ Lily: Yes, the organic compounds released by trees, called phytoncides, boost our immune function.
secenekler: I always try to go for a walk in the forest when I am stressed at work.
Is there actual physiological evidence showing how trees affect our health?
Many luxury wellness resorts are now offering guided forest bathing tours.
I prefer traditional therapy methods like counseling over natural remedies.
Forest conservation is crucial for preserving global biodiversity and clean air.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Evet, ağaçlar tarafından salgılanan fitonsit adı verilen organik bileşikler bağışıklık fonksiyonumuzu güçlendirir" açıklaması, Sam'in ağaçların sağlığımızı nasıl etkilediğine dair fizyolojik kanıt (physiological evidence) olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Alice: Remote work allows people to avoid the stress and expense of daily commuting. Bob: ______ Alice: That's a critical challenge, but many find that setting strict work hours at home helps.
secenekler: I would love to work from home because it saves a lot of petrol money.
But many remote workers struggle with separating their professional and personal lives.
Commuting by train is actually a great time to read books or listen to podcasts.
Most companies require their employees to be online during standard office hours.
How do managers actually monitor the productivity of their remote staff?
aciklama: Alice'in "Bu kritik bir zorluk, ancak birçoğu evde katı çalışma saatleri belirlemenin yardımcı olduğunu düşünüyor" açıklaması, Bob'un uzaktan çalışanların profesyonel ve kişisel yaşamlarını ayırmakta (B seçeneğindeki separating professional and personal lives) zorlandıklarını belirttiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: James: Do you think commercial space travel will ever be safe enough for ordinary tourists? Emily: ______ James: I agree. High-tech sensors and advanced materials are making spaceflight much more reliable.
secenekler: Space tourism is still a luxury that only billionaires can afford right now.
Yes, as engineering and safety standards improve, the risks will decrease significantly.
I don't think ordinary citizens are interested in traveling to space anyway.
The government should ban private space companies to protect the atmosphere.
How long does a typical astronaut train before going on a mission to space?
aciklama: James'in boşluktan sonra "Katılıyorum. Yüksek teknolojili sensörler ve gelişmiş malzemeler uzay uçuşlarını çok daha güvenilir hale getiriyor" tespiti, Emily'nin mühendislik ve güvenlik standartları geliştikçe risklerin önemli ölçüde azalacağını (B seçeneği) belirttiği olumlu tespitiyle uyumludur.

soru_metni: Nancy: Practicing mindful breathing can quickly calm the nervous system during stress. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, deep belly breathing stimulates the vagus nerve, which triggers a relaxation response.
secenekler: I always try to meditate for at least fifteen minutes every morning.
Is there a biological mechanism behind how breathing physically reduces anxiety?
Many yoga classes focus heavily on breathing techniques and core posture.
Do you feel calmer since you started practicing mindful breathing exercises?
Most people don't realize how shallow their daily breathing actually is.
aciklama: Nancy boşluktan sonra "Evet, derin karın nefesi, gevşeme tepkisini tetikleyen vagus sinirini uyarır" diyerek biyolojik mekanizmayı açıklamaktadır. George'un nefes almanın kaygıyı fiziksel olarak nasıl azalttığının arkasındaki biyolojik mekanizmayı (biological mechanism) sorduğu B seçeneği akışı mükemmel kurar.

soru_metni: Clara: I think traditional printed encyclopedias are completely obsolete because of the internet. Alex: ______ Clara: True, but we still need editors to ensure the information online is accurate.
secenekler: I still have a massive collection of printed books in my home library.
But they offered curated, peer-reviewed accuracy that online forums often lack.
Wikipedia is updated in real-time by thousands of volunteers globally.
How much does a typical multi-volume encyclopedia set cost to print?
Most young students do not know how to search for facts in a physical book.
aciklama: Clara'nın "Doğru, ancak çevrimiçi bilgilerin doğru olduğundan emin olmak için hala editörlere ihtiyacımız var" savunması, Alex'in basılı ansiklopedilerin çevrimiçi forumların sunamadığı küratörlü ve hakemli doğruluğu (B seçeneğindeki peer-reviewed accuracy) sunduğunu belirttiği tespitiyle örtüşür.

soru_metni: Michael: The restoration of urban green spaces can significantly lower city temperatures. Sarah: ______ Michael: Exactly. Plants absorb heat and cool the air through transpirational cooling.
secenekler: Urban parks are also great places for residents to exercise and socialize.
How do trees and vegetation actually manage to cool down entire neighborhoods?
I think air conditioning is more reliable for fighting extreme summer heat.
Green roof installation projects require massive funding from local municipalities.
Many bird and insect species rely on urban green spaces to survive in cities.
aciklama: Michael boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle. Bitkiler ısıyı emer ve terleme yoluyla havayı soğutur" diyerek mekanizmayı açıklamaktadır. Sarah'nın ağaç ve bitki örtüsünün tüm mahalleleri nasıl soğuttuğunu sorduğu B seçeneği bu fiziki açıklamayı mükemmel tamamlar.

soru_metni: Victor: I think learning a musical instrument is the best way to enhance brain plasticity. Rachel: ______ Victor: Because it coordinates motor, auditory, and visual processing systems simultaneously.
secenekler: Playing the piano requires many years of daily discipline and patience.
What is the neurological explanation for why music has such a powerful effect?
I am currently trying to learn how to play the classical guitar online.
Is it easier to learn a musical instrument as a child or as an adult?
Most professional musicians have been playing since they were very young.
aciklama: Victor'ın boşluktan sonra "Çünkü motor, işitsel ve görsel işleme sistemlerini aynı anda koordine eder" açıklaması, Rachel'ın müzik aleti öğrenmenin beyindeki bu güçlü etkisinin arkasındaki nörolojik açıklamayı (neurological explanation) sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Paul: Electric buses should completely replace diesel vehicles in all major city centers. Diana: ______ Paul: I understand that, but the reduction in urban air pollution would save millions in healthcare.
secenekler: Electric vehicle technology is improving rapidly with better battery storage.
But wouldn't the high initial cost of buying electric fleets strain city budgets?
I think hydrogen-powered buses are a cleaner alternative to electric ones.
Many commuters complain about the noise levels in old diesel city buses.
How much electrical energy does a typical electric bus consume per kilometer?
aciklama: Paul'ün "Bunu anlıyorum, ancak kentsel hava kirliliğindeki azalma sağlık hizmetlerinde milyonlarca lira tasarruf sağlar" açıklaması, Diana'nın elektrikli otobüs filoları satın almanın yüksek başlangıç maliyetinin (B seçeneğindeki high initial cost) şehir bütçesini zorlayacağını belirttiği mali endişeye cevap niteliğindedir.

soru_metni: Brian: Placing rare historical artifacts behind glass cases makes them feel dead to visitors. Leo: ______ Brian: Exactly! Interactive virtual reality tours would allow people to examine them closely.
secenekler: Most museums are funded by government grants and private donations.
That's why we need to use digital technology to bring those artifacts back to life.
I think touching delicate objects is highly dangerous for their preservation.
Artifacts are too fragile to be handled by ordinary people without training.
Historical objects should only be analyzed by professional archaeologists.
aciklama: Brian'ın boşluktan sonra sanal gerçeklik turlarının (VR tours) nesnelerin yakından incelenmesini sağlayacağına değinmesi, Leo'nun müzeleri canlandırmak için dijital teknolojiyi (digital technology) kullanmamız gerektiğini belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Amy: I think standard standardized tests fail to measure actual linguistic competence. Kevin: ______ Amy: That's a fair point. A structured analytical test is much easier to evaluate objectively.
secenekler: Yes, standardized tests mostly measure grammatical and vocabulary memorization.
But they are still the most practical way to assess thousands of candidates efficiently.
I scored very high on the listening comprehension section of the last exam.
Do you think language speaking tests are fairer than multiple-choice exams?
Many universities require minimum test scores for international student admissions.
aciklama: Amy'nin "Bu adil bir nokta. Yapılandırılmış analitik bir testi objektif olarak değerlendirmek çok daha kolay" yanıtı, Kevin'ın standart sınavların binlerce adayı değerlendirmek için en pratik yol (B seçeneği) olduğunu savunduğu tespitiyle uyumludur.

soru_metni: John: The rise of ride-sharing apps was supposed to reduce carbon emissions, but the opposite happened. Lisa: ______ John: Studies show they attract people who would otherwise walk or use public transit.
secenekler: Ride-sharing services are usually much cheaper than traditional taxis.
Why do you think these applications have actually increased city emissions?
Most drivers work for multiple ride-sharing platforms at the same time.
The city council should impose a congestion tax on all private vehicles.
I always use public buses because they have dedicated transit lanes.
