aciklama: John boşluktan sonra "Araştırmalar, aksi takdirde yürüyecek veya toplu taşıma kullanacak insanları kendine çektiğini gösteriyor" diyerek emisyon artışının nedenini açıklamaktadır. Lisa'nın bu uygulamaların neden emisyonları artırdığını (B seçeneği) sorduğu soru akışa tam oturur.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I believe that reading physical novels enhances empathy more than watching films. George: ______ Evelyn: True. Because reading forces you to construct the characters' inner thoughts yourself.
secenekler: Films are much faster at delivering complex stories to a large audience.
Yes, because physical books don't have visual distractions like special effects.
But both mediums can present highly emotional and complex human narratives.
Do you prefer reading classic literature or modern psychological thrillers?
I think empathy is a trait that is genetically determined at birth.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Doğru. Çünkü okumak sizi karakterlerin iç düşüncelerini kendiniz inşa etmeye zorlıyor" açıklaması, George'un her iki mecranın da (hem kitapların hem de filmlerin) son derece duygusal ve karmaşık insani anlatılar sunabileceğini (C seçeneği) belirterek getirdiği karşılaştırmaya verilen tamamlayıcı bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Arthur: Micro-plastics are now being detected in remote glacier water far from city centers. Clara: ______ Arthur: Atmospheric wind currents carry the tiny plastic fibers high into the sky, distributing them.
secenekler: Most plastic pollution in the oceans comes from major urban rivers.
How do they actually manage to travel such vast distances through the air?
We should ban single-use plastic packaging in all commercial products.
Are micro-plastics dangerous to human health when ingested through water?
I always carry a canvas tote bag when I go to the local market.
aciklama: Arthur boşluktan sonra "Atmosferik rüzgar akımları hafif plastik lifleri gökyüzünün üst katmanlarına taşır ve dağıtır" diyerek taşınma mekanizmasını açıklamaktadır. Clara'nın bu plastiklerin havada bu kadar uzun mesafeleri nasıl katettiğini sorduğu B seçeneği diyalogu bağlar.

soru_metni: Lucas: I think high schools should replace traditional gym classes with lifestyle health education. Sophia: ______ Lucas: Exactly. Teaching them nutrition, sleep hygiene, and stress coping is far more useful for adult life.
secenekler: I played competitive soccer and basketball when I was in high school.
Yes, because physical fitness is about much more than just playing sports.
Traditional physical education classes are very popular among athletic kids.
Do you think schools have the budget to hire professional nutritionists?
Chronic diseases like diabetes are rising rapidly among young teenagers.
aciklama: Lucas'ın "Aynen öyle. Onlara beslenmeyi, uyku hijyenini ve stresle başa çıkmayı öğretmek yetişkinlik hayatlarında çok daha faydalıdır" tespiti, Sophia'nın sağlıklı kalmanın sadece spor yapmaktan çok daha fazlası olduğunu (B seçeneği) belirterek spor derslerinin ötesine geçilmesi gerektiğini desteklediği tespitiyle örtüşür.

soru_metni: Sarah: I'm trying to practice 'digital minimalism' by keeping my phone screen grayscale. Tom: ______ Sarah: It removes the bright visual rewards that trigger dopamine loops, making the phone boring.
secenekler: I think modern smartphones have incredibly beautiful OLED displays.
How does changing the screen color actually reduce your phone usage?
I always use a blue light filter in the evening to protect my eyes.
Digital minimalism is just a passing trend for tech enthusiasts.
Which mobile applications do you spend the most time on daily?
aciklama: Sarah boşluktan sonra "Telefonun ekranını gri tonlamalı yapmanın, dopamin döngülerini tetikleyen parlak görsel ödülleri ortadan kaldırdığını ve telefonu sıkıcı hale getirdiğini" açıklamaktadır. Tom'un ekran rengini değiştirmenin telefon kullanımını nasıl azalttığını (B seçeneği) sorduğu soru bu açıklamayı doğrudan tetikler.

soru_metni: Oliver: The preservation of native crop varieties is essential for global agricultural security. Emma: ______ Oliver: Exactly. They contain diverse genetic traits that can resist new plant diseases or extreme climate shifts.
secenekler: Genetically modified crops are much easier and cheaper to grow.
Yes, because a single disease could wipe out monoculture farming entirely.
Most modern supermarkets only sell a few commercial varieties of apples.
Organic farming requires more manual labor and natural fertilizers.
How do scientists store endangered seeds for future generations?
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Aynen öyle. Yeni bitki hastalıklarına veya aşırı iklim değişikliklerine direnebilecek çeşitli genetik özellikler içerirler" açıklaması, Emma'nın tek tip tarımın (monoculture) tek bir hastalıkla tamamen yok olabileceğini ve bu yüzden yerli türlerin korunması gerektiğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki haklı uyarısını onaylar.

soru_metni: Jack: I think virtual reality will eventually replace physical business trips completely. Clara: ______ Jack: True, but for casual project updates and routine check-ins, VR is much more efficient.
secenekler: High-quality VR headsets are still too heavy to wear for hours.
Yes, because companies are trying to reduce their travel expenses anyway.
But building deep trust with clients often requires physical, face-to-face meetings.
How much does a typical international flight cost for a business executive?
Many hotels are opening dedicated coworking spaces for travelers.
aciklama: Jack'in boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak sıradan proje güncellemeleri ve rutin kontroller için VR çok daha verimlidir" diyerek esnemesi, Clara'nın derin güven ilişkisi kurmak için yüz yüze fiziksel toplantıların (face-to-face meetings) şart olduğunu belirttiği C seçeneğindeki eleştirisine hak verdiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Nancy: I started using a blue light filter on all my digital screens after sunset. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, my eyes feel much less strained, and I find myself falling asleep more easily.
secenekler: Blue light filters make the screen look too orange and warm.
Have you noticed any real improvement in your sleep or eye comfort?
I always turn off my computer at least two hours before going to bed.
Blue light from screens has been linked to macular degeneration.
Most modern laptops have a built-in night mode feature.
aciklama: Nancy'nin "Evet, gözlerimde çok daha az yorgunluk hissediyorum ve daha kolay uykuya daldığımı fark ediyorum" yanıtı, George'un bu filtrenin uyku veya göz konforunda gerçek bir iyileşme (real improvement) sağlayıp sağlamadığını merak ettiği B seçeneğindeki sorusunun cevabıdır.

soru_metni: David: I believe the gig economy exploitation can only be solved through federal labor laws. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. If companies are not legally forced to provide benefits, they will continue to avoid them.
secenekler: Many freelancers actually enjoy the flexibility of gig work models.
Yes, because voluntary corporate guidelines are rarely effective for worker rights.
The government should reduce income taxes for independent freelancers.
How do ride-sharing drivers calculate their net earnings after fuel?
Most labor unions are already protesting against gig economy platforms.
aciklama: David'in "Aynen öyle. Şirketler yasal olarak yan hakları sağlamaya zorlanmazlarsa, bundan kaçınmaya devam edecekler" açıklaması, Sarah'nın şirketlerin gönüllü rehber ilkelerinin işçi hakları için nadiren etkili olduğunu (B seçeneğindeki voluntary corporate guidelines) belirttiği tespitiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Paul: Noise-canceling headphones are a lifesaver for open-plan office workers. Laura: ______ Paul: True, but without them, the constant background chatter makes deep work impossible.
secenekler: I prefer working in absolute silence inside a private office cubicle.
Yes, but they can isolate you too much, making casual team collaboration harder.
Noise-canceling technology has become incredibly cheap to purchase lately.
Most open-plan offices are designed to encourage transparency and trust.
How long does the battery of a typical noise-canceling headset last?
aciklama: Paul'ün boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak onlar olmadan sürekli arka plan gürültüsü derinlemesine çalışmayı (deep work) imkansız hale getiriyor" demesi, Laura'nın bu kulaklıkların insanı ekipten aşırı izole edebileceğini ve ekip çalışmasını zorlaştırabileceğini (B seçeneğindeki isolate you too much) belirttiği eleştirisine karşı bir savunmadır.

soru_metni: Kevin: Standardized testing has completely narrowed down the curriculum in high schools. Rachel: ______ Kevin: Exactly. Teachers end up 'teaching to the test' instead of fostering creativity and critical thinking.
secenekler: Standardized exams are the only objective way to evaluate students globally.
Yes, subjects that are not tested, like arts and music, are often neglected.
I scored ninety-eight points on the national science exam myself.
Do you think essay-based exams are fairer than multiple-choice tests?
Many schools are investing heavily in modern STEM laboratories now.
aciklama: Kevin'ın "Aynen öyle. Öğretmenler yaratıcılığı ve eleştirel düşünmeyi teşvik etmek yerine sadece 'sınava yönelik eğitim' veriyorlar" açıklaması, Rachel'ın sınavda sorulmayan sanat ve müzik gibi derslerin ihmal edildiğini (B seçeneği) belirten tespitini onaylar ve somutlaştırır.

soru_metni: Lily: I find it fascinating how bioluminescent organisms can produce light without heat. Sam: ______ Lily: Yes, they use a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase enzymes.
secenekler: Most deep-sea fish are bioluminescent to attract prey in the dark.
Is there a specific biochemical process behind this cold light generation?
I saw a documentary about bioluminescent mushrooms in a Japanese forest.
Bioluminescence is also being researched for sustainable street lighting.
How do fireflies manage to flash their lights in perfect synchronization?
aciklama: Lily'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, lusiferin ve lusiferaz enzimlerini içeren kimyasal bir reaksiyon kullanırlar" diyerek biyokimyasal süreci açıklaması, Sam'in bu soğuk ışık üretiminin (cold light generation) arkasında özel bir biyokimyasal süreç (specific biochemical process) olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Alice: Implementing congestion pricing in downtown areas is the best way to ease traffic. Bob: ______ Alice: That's a valid concern, which is why the revenue should be used to make public transit cheaper.
secenekler: Congestion taxes have been highly successful in London and Singapore.
But wouldn't that place an unfair financial burden on low-income commuters?
I prefer driving my car even if I have to pay high parking fees.
How do they actually monitor which cars enter the pricing zone?
Most people would support the tax if it reduced air pollution levels.
aciklama: Alice'in "Bu haklı bir endişe, bu yüzden elde edilen gelir toplu taşımayı daha ucuz hale getirmek için kullanılmalıdır" açıklaması, Bob'un sıkışıklık vergisinin düşük gelirli çalışanlar üzerinde adaletsiz bir finansal yük (financial burden on low-income commuters) yaratacağına dair getirdiği B seçeneğindeki sosyo-ekonomik eleştirisine bir çözümdür.

soru_metni: James: I think the constant pursuit of productivity is actually making us less creative. Emily: ______ James: Exactly. True creativity requires idle time and boredom for the mind to wander freely.
secenekler: Many companies are trying to implement a four-day workweek lately.
Yes, when every hour is optimized, there is no space for random experimentation.
I always use a time-tracking app to organize my daily task list.
Do you think creative thinking is a skill that can be taught in schools?
Most artists are highly disciplined and work on a very strict schedule.
aciklama: James'in "Aynen öyle. Gerçek yaratıcılık, zihnin serbestçe gezinmesi için boş zaman ve can sıkıntısı gerektirir" tespiti, Emily'nin her saatin optimize edilmesinin rastgele deneyler yapmaya (random experimentation) yer bırakmadığını belirttiği B seçeneğini tam olarak doğrular. soru_metni: Amy: I've noticed that many people are choosing slow-travel options like trains over fast flights nowadays. Tom: ______ Amy: Exactly. Plus, it allows you to truly experience the changing landscapes and local cultures along the way.
secenekler: I think flying is always the most comfortable and cheapest option.
Yes, because it dramatically reduces the carbon emissions associated with your trip.
Slow travel is only popular among retired people who have too much time.
How much does a typical high-speed train ticket cost in Europe?
Most modern train stations are located far outside the city centers.
aciklama: Tom'un boşlukta yavaş seyahatin (slow-travel) çevresel bir avantajından, yani karbon emisyonunu ciddi ölçüde azaltmasından (B seçeneği) bahsetmesi gerekir. Amy'nin "Exactly" (Aynen öyle) diyerek bu duruma katılması ve "Plus..." (Ayrıca...) diyerek manzara deneyimi gibi diğer avantajları eklemesi akışı mükemmel tamamlar.

soru_metni: David: I believe that learning to play a musical instrument should be a part of every child's school curriculum. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. It sharpens their focus and teaches them that progress requires consistent daily effort.
secenekler: Most schools cannot afford to buy expensive musical instruments for students.
Yes, because it significantly enhances their cognitive development and discipline.
I think physical education and sports are more beneficial for young kids.
Do you prefer playing the classical piano or the acoustic guitar?
Most children lose interest in practicing music after just a few weeks.
aciklama: David'in boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle. Odaklanmalarını keskinleştirir ve gelişimin günlük istikrarlı çaba gerektirdiğini öğretir" demesi, Sarah'nın enstrüman çalmanın bilişsel gelişim ve disiplin üzerindeki faydalarını (B seçeneği) belirttiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Olivia: The integration of virtual reality in school history lessons is absolutely revolutionary. Ethan: ______ Olivia: True, but experiencing a virtual walk through ancient Athens is far more memorable than reading a textbook.
secenekler: I always scored very high on my history exams when I was in school.
But aren't high-quality VR headsets still too expensive for public schools?
Virtual reality technology is expanding rapidly into the medical field too.
Many students complain that VR headsets make them feel dizzy and nauseous.
I think traditional teachers are still necessary to explain complex events.
aciklama: Olivia'nın "True, but..." (Doğru, ama...) diyerek sanal Antik Atina yürüyüşünün ders kitabından daha akılda kalıcı olduğunu savunması, Ethan'ın cihazların devlet okulları için hala çok pahalı olduğu (B seçeneği) yönündeki mali çekincesini onayladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Sophia: I find that listening to classical music while studying helps me absorb information much faster. Liam: ______ Sophia: Exactly. Without distracting lyrics, your brain can focus entirely on the material you are reading.
secenekler: I prefer listening to heavy metal or rock music when I am working out.
Yes, because instrumental sounds stimulate focus without cluttering your thoughts.
Classical music has been proven to temporarily boost a person's IQ score.
Which specific classical composers do you listen to the most while working?
I cannot study in absolute silence because it makes me feel very anxious.
aciklama: Sophia'nın "Aynen öyle. Dikkat dağıtıcı şarkı sözleri olmadan beyniniz tamamen okuduğunuz materyale odaklanabilir" yanıtı, Liam'ın enstrümantal seslerin zihni bulandırmadan odaklanmayı artırdığına (B seçeneği) yönelik yaptığı tespitle tam bir uyum içindedir.

soru_metni: Emma: I think that fast-fashion brands should be legally held responsible for their textile waste. Lucas: ______ Emma: That's a fair point. However, strict environmental regulations might force them to adopt circular models.
secenekler: Most fast-fashion items are made of cheap synthetic materials like polyester.
But wouldn't enforcing those laws be incredibly difficult on a global scale?
Many consumers are now choosing to buy clothes from sustainable local brands.
Textile factories in developing countries employ millions of low-income workers.
I always donate my old and worn-out clothes to charity organizations.
aciklama: Emma'nın boşluktan sonra "Bu adil bir nokta. Ancak katı çevre düzenlemeleri onları döngüsel modelleri benimsemeye zorlayabilir" açıklaması, Lucas'ın bu yasaların küresel ölçekte uygulanmasının inanılmaz derecede zor olacağına (B seçeneği) dair getirdiği haklı eleştiriyi doğrular.

soru_metni: Zoe: The popularity of online plant shops has made urban gardening accessible to everyone. Ryan: ______ Zoe: True. It is so convenient that even people with tiny apartments are growing their own herbs now.
secenekler: Most indoor plants require a lot of indirect sunlight and high humidity to survive.
Yes, it has simplified the process of getting soil, seeds, and advice delivered home.
I always buy my garden plants from the traditional local nursery nearby.
Urban gardening is just a temporary modern trend driven by social media influencers.
How much does a typical organic herb growing kit cost online nowadays?
aciklama: Zoe'nin "Doğru. O kadar pratik ki küçük dairesi olan insanlar bile artık kendi otlarını yetiştiriyor" tespiti, Ryan'ın çevrimiçi siparişlerin toprak, tohum ve tavsiyelerin eve teslim edilmesini kolaylaştırdığına (B seçeneği) dair pratiklik vurgusunu destekler.

soru_metni: Leo: I think the city council should charge a congestion fee for cars entering the downtown area. Maya: ______ Leo: That's a valid concern, but the fee revenues could be directly used to make buses cheaper.
secenekler: Traffic congestion in our downtown is getting worse with every new office building.
But wouldn't that place an unfair financial burden on low-income drivers who must work there?
I always use my bicycle to commute because it is much healthier than driving.
Congestion fees have been highly successful in reducing pollution in London and Stockholm.
Most people would gladly support the fee if they knew it would clear up the roads.
aciklama: Leo'nun "Bu haklı bir endişe, ancak ücret gelirleri doğrudan otobüsleri ucuzlatmak için kullanılabilir" savunması, Maya'nın bu ücretin orada çalışmak zorunda olan düşük gelirli sürücülere haksız bir mali yük (B seçeneği) getireceği yönündeki sosyal adalet kaygısına verilmiş mantıklı bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Lily: I believe that regular creative writing exercises can significantly improve a person's empathy. James: ______ Lily: Exactly. It forces you to step inside a character's mind and see the world through their eyes.
secenekler: Creative writing is a skill that can only be developed through years of study.
Yes, because imagining other people's inner struggles builds emotional understanding.
I always read classic psychological thriller novels to relax during my weekends.
Most high school English classes do not focus enough on creative writing skills.
Empathy is a natural personality trait that cannot be changed through practice.
aciklama: Lily'nın "Aynen öyle. Sizi bir karakterin zihnine girmeye ve dünyayı onların gözünden görmeye zorlar" açıklaması, James'in başkalarının içsel mücadelelerini hayal etmenin duygusal anlayışı (B seçeneğindeki emotional understanding) geliştirdiğini belirttiği tespitiyle mükemmel bağlanır.

soru_metni: Anna: I've started using a specialized app to track the nutritional value of my daily meals. David: ______ Anna: Yes, it highlights exactly which vitamins or fiber I am missing, helping me eat better.
secenekler: Most nutritional apps are highly inaccurate because they rely on user inputs.
Has having access to that detailed nutritional breakdown changed your eating choices?
I always try to cook balanced organic meals at home instead of eating out.
How much does a premium subscription to that health tracking app cost monthly?
I prefer consulting a professional registered dietitian for personalized advice.
aciklama: Anna'nın "Evet, hangi vitamin veya liflerin eksik olduğunu tam olarak vurgulayarak daha iyi beslenmeme yardımcı oluyor" cevabı, David'in bu detaylı besin dökümünün (nutritional breakdown) yeme seçimlerini değiştirip değiştirmediğini sorduğu B seçeneğindeki sorusunun doğrudan karşılığıdır.

soru_metni: Chloe: I think that university lectures should be recorded and made available online for all students. Daniel: ______ Chloe: True, but for review purposes and students who are sick, it would be an invaluable resource.
secenekler: Most professors already use slide presentations during their lecture hours.
But wouldn't that encourage students to skip classes, reducing real campus interaction?
Online education became highly popular globally during the recent pandemic years.
Many students do not have access to high-speed internet connections at home.
Recording high-quality video lectures requires expensive camera equipment for schools.
aciklama: Chloe'nin "Doğru, ancak tekrar yapma amacıyla ve hasta olan öğrenciler için paha biçilemez bir kaynak olurdu" savunması, Daniel'ın bu uygulamanın öğrencileri dersleri asmaya ve kampüs etkileşimini azaltmaya (B seçeneği) teşvik edip etmeyeceğini sorduğu endişesine yönelik bir yumuşatmadır.

soru_metni: Victor: I think local councils should replace concrete pavements with permeable grass pavers. Rachel: ______ Victor: Because it allows rainwater to soak directly into the ground, preventing urban flash floods.
secenekler: Permeable grass pavers are much more difficult and expensive to keep clean.
What is the main ecological benefit of using permeable grass instead of concrete?
Concrete is still the most durable and cost-effective material for high-traffic paths.
How much does it cost to pave a standard residential street with these pavers?
Most modern landscape architects prefer using natural materials over artificial ones.
aciklama: Victor'ın boşluktan sonra "Çünkü yağmur suyunun doğrudan toprağa sızmasını sağlayarak kentsel ani sel baskınlarını önler" diyerek ekolojik faydayı açıklaması, Rachel'ın geçirgen çim kullanmanın beton üzerindeki temel ekolojik faydasını (B seçeneğindeki ecological benefit) sorduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paul: Keeping our personal computers on all night is a major waste of electricity. Diana: ______ Paul: Exactly. We are talking about millions of devices globally drawing power needlessly.
secenekler: I always shut down my computer completely before going to bed at night.
Yes, even in sleep mode, they still consume a small but continuous amount of standby power.
Most modern computers are designed to be highly energy-efficient nowadays.
How much does a typical desktop computer add to your monthly utility bill?
I think the government should enforce automatic sleep timers on all electronic goods.
aciklama: Paul'ün "Aynen öyle. Küresel ölçekte milyonlarca cihazın gereksiz yere güç çekmesinden bahsediyoruz" açıklaması, Diana'nın bilgisayarların uyku modunda bile küçük ama sürekli bir yedek güç (standby power) tükettiğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki teknik tespitini doğrular.

soru_metni: Brian: The extreme specialization in modern science prevents researchers from seeing the bigger picture. Leo: ______ Brian: Exactly! We need more interdisciplinary studies where experts from different fields collaborate closely.
secenekler: Science has advanced more in the last fifty years than in the previous thousand.
That's a valid point. Scientists often work in isolated silos, ignoring related discoveries.
I think getting a PhD in physics requires too much dedication and narrow study.
Many universities are now offering broad general science courses for undergraduates.
How do scientific journals evaluate research papers that cross multiple disciplines?
aciklama: Brian'ın boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle! Farklı alanlardan uzmanların yakın işbirliği yaptığı daha fazla disiplinler arası çalışmaya ihtiyacımız var" tespiti, Leo'nun bilim insanlarının genellikle yalıtılmış silolarda çalışarak diğer keşifleri görmezden geldiği (B seçeneğindeki isolated silos) yönündeki eleştirisini doğrudan onaylar.

soru_metni: Amy: I struggled immensely with the listening section of the TOEFL exam. Kevin: ______ Amy: Mostly because the speakers had different regional accents and spoke at a very natural pace.
secenekler: You should practice mock tests under strict exam conditions to reduce anxiety.
What do you think was the primary reason for your difficulty in that section?
Listening is generally considered the easiest part of language proficiency tests.
Did you have high-quality noise-canceling headphones during your test session?
I scored a perfect thirty on the writing section of the TOEFL exam myself.
aciklama: Amy'nin boşluktan sonra "Çoğunlukla konuşmacıların farklı bölgesel aksanlara sahip olması ve çok doğal bir hızda konuşması nedeniyle" demesi, Kevin'ın ona bu bölümde yaşadığı zorluğun birincil nedenini (primary reason) sorduğu B seçeneğini gerektirir.

soru_metni: John: I think all public university admissions should be based on student portfolios, not standardized tests. Lisa: ______ John: Exactly. A single three-hour exam cannot possibly capture a student's years of talent and growth.
secenekler: Portfolios are much harder and more subjective to grade than standardized tests.
Yes, because a portfolio shows a comprehensive, long-term picture of a student's abilities.
Many private colleges already use portfolios alongside standard entrance exams.
How would high schools adapt their curriculums to help students build these portfolios?
Most parents prefer the objective nature of multiple-choice entrance exams.
aciklama: John'un "Kesinlikle. Tek bir üç saatlik sınav, bir öğrencinin yıllarca süren yeteneğini ve gelişimini yakalayamaz" tespiti, Lisa'nın portfolyoların öğrencinin yeteneklerinin kapsamlı ve uzun vadeli bir resmini (long-term picture) gösterdiğini belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrudan onaylar.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I've noticed that I feel much more anxious on days when I spend hours on social media. George: ______ Evelyn: Exactly. Comparing your daily life to other people's curated highlight reels is very unhealthy.
secenekler: Social media platforms are constantly updating their privacy policy guidelines.
That's because social media is designed to trigger constant social comparison and FOMO.
I always turn off all my digital notifications when I am at the office working.
How many followers do you currently have on your personal social media accounts?
I think social media is a great tool for staying in touch with distant relatives.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Kesinlikle. Günlük hayatınızı başkalarının seçilmiş, filtrelenmiş en iyi anlarıyla karşılaştırmak çok sağlıksız" tespiti, George'un sosyal medyanın sürekli sosyal karşılaştırmayı (social comparison) tetikleyecek şekilde tasarlandığını belirttiği B seçeneğindeki tespiti doğrular.

soru_metni: Arthur: I think high schools should teach basic home maintenance skills, like plumbing and electrical wiring. Clara: ______ Arthur: Absolutely. Being self-reliant in daily life is just as important as academic knowledge.
secenekler: Plumbing services are becoming extremely expensive in major cities nowadays.
Yes, these are practical life skills that can save adults thousands of dollars over time.
I didn't learn how to change a lightbulb until I moved into my own apartment.
Do you think high school students would find home maintenance classes too boring?
Many schools are already focusing more on advanced computer programming classes instead.
aciklama: Arthur'un boşluktan sonra "Kesinlikle. Günlük hayatta kendi kendine yetebilmek, akademik bilgi kadar önemlidir" demesi, Clara'nın bu pratik yaşam becerilerinin (practical life skills) yetişkinlere zaman içinde binlerce dolar tasarruf sağlayabileceğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki tespitiyle tam uyumludur.

soru_metni: Lucas: I believe the rise of automated drone delivery will make traditional delivery drivers obsolete. Sophia: ______ Lucas: True, but for densely populated urban apartments, human navigation is still far more reliable.
secenekler: Drone technology is already being used in agriculture to monitor crop health.
But can drones safely navigate around complex city structures, wires, and bad weather?
Yes, because drone delivery has become incredibly fast and cheap for e-commerce companies.
I am currently working as a drone pilot for a private security company in this city.
Most consumers prefer getting their online orders delivered right to their doorstep.
aciklama: Lucas'ın boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak yoğun nüfuslu kentsel apartmanlar için insan navigasyonu hala çok daha güvenilirdir" diyerek esnemesi, Sophia'nın drone'ların şehir yapıları, kablolar ve kötü hava koşullarında (B seçeneği) güvenle seyredip seyredemeyeceğine dair getirdiği haklı eleştiriyi kabul ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Sarah: The transition to wind energy has some unforeseen environmental downsides. Tom: ______ Sarah: Exactly. It poses a significant threat to migratory birds and bats if built in their flight paths.
secenekler: Because wind turbines require a lot of steel and concrete to construct?
Yes, especially regarding its physical impact on local wildlife and bird populations.
Many European countries are leading the way in building offshore wind farms.
How much electrical energy can a single giant offshore wind turbine generate?
I think solar energy is a much cleaner and safer alternative to wind turbines.
aciklama: Sarah'nın "Aynen öyle. Uçuş rotalarına inşa edilirse göçmen kuşlar ve yarasalar için büyük bir tehdit oluşturuyor" tespiti, Tom'un rüzgar enerjisinin yerel yaban hayatı ve kuş popülasyonları üzerindeki fiziksel etkisine (B seçeneği) değindiği tespitiyle kusursuz örtüşür.

soru_metni: Oliver: I find it hard to maintain my exercise routine when traveling for business. Emma: ______ Oliver: That's an excellent idea. Doing a quick session in my hotel room would save a lot of time.
secenekler: You should look for luxury hotels that have fully equipped modern gyms.
Have you tried using bodyweight workout apps that require no gym equipment at all?
I always try to go for a outdoor run in the city center when I travel.
Traveling for business is usually extremely exhausting and leaves very little free time.
Most hotel gyms are very small and only have a couple of treadmill machines.
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Bu mükemmel bir fikir. Otel odamda yapacağım hızlı bir seans çok zaman kazandıracaktır" demesi, Emma'nın ona spor salonu ekipmanı gerektirmeyen, kendi vücut ağırlığıyla çalışabileceği egzersiz uygulamalarını (B seçeneği) önerdiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Jack: Most people don't realize how much carbon is emitted by streaming high-definition videos. Clara: ______ Jack: Playing HD videos continuously requires massive, power-hungry servers to process the data in real-time.
secenekler: I always download my favorite movies instead of streaming them online to save data.
How does streaming digital videos actually generate physical carbon emissions in the real world?
Video streaming platforms are making billions of dollars from monthly user subscriptions.
Do you think governments should enforce carbon taxes on major streaming companies?
Most modern data centers are now located in cold regions to reduce cooling energy costs.
aciklama: Jack'in boşluktan sonra "HD videoları kesintisiz oynatmak, verileri gerçek zamanlı olarak işlemek için devasa, yüksek güç tüketen sunucular gerektirir" diyerek süreci açıklaması, Clara'nın dijital video akışının fiziksel dünyada nasıl karbon emisyonu ürettiğini (B seçeneği) sorduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Nancy: Prolonged periods of staring at computer screens can lead to 'computer vision syndrome.' George: ______ Nancy: Yes, we blink sixty percent less when looking at screens, causing dry eyes and strain.
secenekler: I think taking a ten-minute break every hour is the best cure for eye strain.
Is there a biological explanation for why screens cause so much eye discomfort?
Many modern monitors come with advanced built-in blue light filter settings.
Do you think reading a physical paper book is actually better for your eyesight?
Most eye doctors recommend using lubricating eye drops throughout the working day.
aciklama: Nancy'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, ekranlara bakarken yüzde atmış daha az göz kırparız, bu da göz kuruluğu ve yorgunluğa neden olur" şeklindeki biyolojik/fizyolojik detaylar vermesi, George'un ekranların neden göz rahatsızlığına yol açtığına dair biyolojik bir açıklama (B seçeneğindeki biological explanation) sorduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Lily: I prefer shopping at antique flea markets rather than buying modern replica furniture. Sam: ______ Lily: True, but finding a unique piece with a history and restoring it is incredibly rewarding.
secenekler: Modern replica furniture is usually much lighter and easier to assemble at home.
But isn't it very time-consuming to search through markets to find items in good condition?
I always buy my home decorations from large Swedish retail furniture stores online.
How much does a typical antique oak writing desk cost in flea markets nowadays?
Most antique furniture is made of high-quality solid wood that can last for centuries.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Doğru, ancak geçmişi olan benzersiz bir parça bulup onu restore etmek inanılmaz derecede tatmin edici" savunması, Sam'in iyi durumda olan eşyalar bulmak için pazarlarda arama yapmanın çok zaman alıcı (B seçeneğindeki time-consuming) olup olmadığını sorguladığı şüpheci sorusuna yanıttır.

soru_metni: David: I believe the global loss of biodiversity is just as urgent as climate change. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. The collapse of even a single insect species can disrupt entire agricultural systems.
secenekler: Many endangered animal species are being kept in protected national parks globally.
Yes, because ecosystems rely on complex food webs where every single species plays a role.
I think greenhouse gas emissions are the primary driver of modern ecological crises.
How do biologists actually calculate the total number of extinct species annually?
Biodiversity has been naturally fluctuating throughout the Earth's geological history.
aciklama: David'in "Kesinlikle. Tek bir böcek türünün çöküşü bile tüm tarım sistemlerini bozabilir" tespiti, Sarah'nın ekosistemlerin her bir türün rol oynadığı karmaşık besin ağlarına (B seçeneğindeki food webs) dayandığını belirttiği tespitiyle mükemmel birleşir.

soru_metni: Paul: I think the government should ban plastic single-use coffee cups in all city cafes. Laura: ______ Paul: True, but paper cups are often lined with a thin plastic film, making them hard to recycle anyway.
secenekler: Many cafes are already offering discounts to customers who bring their own travel mugs.
But wouldn't switching to paper cups just cause more forest deforestation globally?
I always bring my own reusable stainless steel thermos when I go to buy coffee.
How much does a fully biodegradable cornstarch coffee cup cost to manufacture?
Plastic pollution in urban rivers is a major threat to municipal drainage systems.
aciklama: Paul'ün boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak kağıt bardaklar da genellikle geri dönüştürülmesini zorlaştıran ince bir plastik filmle kaplıdır" açıklaması, Laura'nın kağıt bardaklara geçmenin küresel ormansızlaşmaya (B seçeneğindeki forest deforestation) yol açıp açmayacağını sorguladığı B seçeneğindeki eleştirisine doğrudan yanıttır.

soru_metni: Kevin: I think AI writing assistants will soon completely eliminate the need for human copywriters. Rachel: ______ Kevin: I understand your skepticism, but AI can generate twenty different ad copies in under five seconds.
secenekler: Modern marketing agencies are spending more money on digital video advertisements lately.
I disagree; AI lacks the creative nuances, human empathy, and cultural understanding needed for marketing.
Many copywriters are already using AI tools to quickly proofread their text drafts.
Which specific artificial intelligence platforms do you use the most in your business?
Most copywriters write very generic product descriptions that require very little creative skill.
aciklama: Kevin'ın "Şüpheciliğini (skepticism) anlıyorum, ancak yapay zeka beş saniyenin altında yirmi farklı reklam metni üretebilir" savunması, Rachel'ın pazarlama için yapay zekanın yaratıcı nüanslardan, insani empatiden ve kültürel anlayıştan (B seçeneği) yoksun olduğunu belirterek karşı çıktığı argümana yöneliktir.

soru_metni: Lily: I've read that gardening has been scientifically proven to lower daily stress hormones. Sam: ______ Lily: Yes, the physical contact with soil bacteria, like Mycobacterium vaccae, triggers serotonin release.
secenekler: I always try to water my balcony plants as soon as I return home from work.
Is there actual chemical or biological evidence showing how plants reduce anxiety?
Many high-end luxury wellness spas are now offering horticultural therapy classes.
I prefer traditional stress relief methods like exercise over planting vegetables.
Urban gardening is crucial for preserving local bee populations in concrete cities.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Evet, Mycobacterium vaccae gibi toprak bakterileriyle kurulan fiziksel temas serotonin salgılanmasını tetikler" açıklaması, Sam'in bitkilerin kaygıyı nasıl azalttığına dair kimyasal veya biyolojik kanıt (B seçeneğindeki chemical or biological evidence) olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Alice: Remote work allows companies to avoid the stress and expense of daily commuting. Bob: ______ Alice: That's a valid logistical concern, but managing different shifts is a trade-off worth making.
secenekler: I would love to work for a tech company in Silicon Valley from my home country.
But how do they manage the challenges of collaborating across completely different time zones?
Relocation packages are usually extremely expensive for startup companies to offer.
Most international remote workers prefer working as independent freelancers for tax benefits.
How do HR managers evaluate the qualifications of candidates from foreign universities?
aciklama: Alice'in "Bu haklı bir lojistik endişe, ancak farklı vardiyaları (different shifts) yönetmek, katlanmaya değer bir bedel" açıklaması, Bob'un farklı saat dilimlerindeki (B seçeneğindeki different time zones) çalışma zorluklarını sorguladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: James: Do you think electric airplanes will ever be viable for long-distance international flights? Emily: ______ James: I agree. Until we develop batteries with much higher energy density, they will be limited to short regional routes.
secenekler: Electric flight technology is currently being funded by major military organizations.
No, because current battery weights make long-haul electric aviation physically impossible.
I don't think international airline passengers are interested in electric planes anyway.
The commercial aviation sector is responsible for around two percent of global emissions.
How much does a typical kerosene-powered passenger jet consume during a transatlantic flight?
aciklama: James'in boşluktan sonra "Katılıyorum. Çok daha yüksek enerji yoğunluğuna sahip piller geliştirene kadar, kısa bölgesel rotalarla sınırlı kalacaklar" tespiti, Emily'nin mevcut pil ağırlıklarının uzun menzilli uçuşları imkansız kıldığını (B seçeneği) belirttiği tespitiyle tam uyumludur.

soru_metni: Nancy: Incorporating plants into office spaces has been shown to significantly boost worker productivity. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, the visual presence of greenery relieves mental fatigue and restores attention levels.
secenekler: I always keep a small succulent plant on my study desk at home.
Is there a psychological mechanism behind why plants improve our focus?
Many modern offices are designed with large floor-to-ceiling glass windows.
Do you feel more energetic since the company placed those plants in the lobby?
Most office plants are very easy to maintain and require very little watering.
aciklama: Nancy boşluktan sonra "Evet, yeşilliğin görsel varlığı zihinsel yorgunluğu giderir ve dikkat seviyelerini yeniler" diyerek psikolojik etkiyi açıklamaktadır. George'un bitkilerin odağı nasıl artırdığının arkasındaki psikolojik mekanizmayı (B seçeneğindeki psychological mechanism) sorduğu B seçeneği akışı mükemmel tamamlar.

soru_metni: Clara: I think physical road maps are completely obsolete because of GPS smartphone applications. Alex: ______ Clara: True, but we still need physical backups in case of dead batteries or no signal areas.
secenekler: I always keep a physical road map in the glove compartment of my personal car.
But GPS apps cannot work when you are driving in remote wilderness zones with no cellular coverage.
Smartphone applications are updated in real-time with live traffic and accident information.
How much does a typical high-quality national road atlas cost to buy nowadays?
Most young drivers do not know how to read the coordinate markings on a paper map.
aciklama: Clara'nın "Doğru, ancak pillerin bitmesi veya sinyal alınamayan alanlar için hala basılı yedeklere ihtiyacımız var" savunması, Alex'in hücresel kapsama alanı olmayan uzak vahşi bölgelerde GPS'in çalışamayacağını (B seçeneği) belirttiği tespitiyle örtüşür.

soru_metni: Michael: Restoring urban salt marshes can protect coastal cities from devastating storm surges. Sarah: ______ Michael: Exactly. They act like natural wave breakers, absorbing and dissipating the kinetic energy of the water.
secenekler: Coastal tourism is a major contributor to the economy of many oceanfront towns.
In what ways do salt marshes actually manage to reduce the impact of incoming waves?
I think massive concrete dikes and seawalls are more reliable for flood defense.
Salt marsh restoration projects are highly complex and require years of ecological monitoring.
Many rare migratory bird species rely on coastal marshes for feeding and resting.
aciklama: Michael boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle. Doğal dalga kıranlar gibi davranırlar; suyin kinetik enerjisini emer ve dağıtırlar" diyerek fiziksel süreci açıklamaktadır. Sarah'nın tuzlu bataklıkların gelen dalgaların etkisini nasıl azalttığını (B seçeneği) sorduğu soru bu açıklamayı mükemmel tamamlar.

soru_metni: Victor: I think learning a second language as a child increases the density of gray matter in the brain. Rachel: ______ Victor: Because managing two different language systems simultaneously strengthens the prefrontal cortex.
secenekler: Bilingual children generally perform much better in creative writing school tasks.
What is the neurological explanation for why bilingualism increases brain density?
I am currently trying to teach my young daughter both English and French at home.
Is it really harder to acquire native-like pronunciation after the age of puberty?
Most primary schools in Europe teach at least one foreign language mandatory.
aciklama: Victor'ın boşluktan sonra "Çünkü iki farklı dil sistemini aynı anda yönetmek prefrontal korteksi güçlendirir" açıklaması, Rachel'ın iki dilliliğin beyin yoğunluğunu neden artırdığına dair nörolojik açıklamayı (B seçeneğindeki neurological explanation) sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan ilişkilidir.

soru_metni: Paul: Smart LED streetlights should be installed across all major municipal districts. Diana: ______ Paul: I understand that, but the seventy percent drop in city electricity bills would pay it back in three years.
secenekler: LED streetlights last much longer and require less maintenance than halogen ones.
But wouldn't the high upfront installation cost strain the city's current fiscal budget?
I think motion-sensor streetlights are a much better option for quiet residential lanes.
Many citizens complain about the harsh blue color of early-generation LED lighting.
How much electrical energy can a single smart municipal streetlight save per night?
aciklama: Paul'ün "Bunu anlıyorum, ancak şehir elektrik faturalarındaki %70'lik düşüş bunu üç yılda geri öder" açıklaması, Diana'nın yüksek başlangıç kurulum maliyetinin (B seçeneğindeki high upfront installation cost) belediye bütçesini zorlayacağını belirttiği mali endişeye cevap niteliğindedir.

soru_metni: Brian: Traditional lectures in university auditoriums are a very passive way of learning. Leo: ______ Brian: Exactly! Flipping the classroom where students study materials at home and discuss them in class is far better.
secenekler: Most universities are now investing heavily in modern high-speed campus Wi-Fi networks.
Yes, because sitting silently for two hours encourages memorization instead of active critical analysis.
I always recorded my college lectures so I could listen to them later before the exams.
Traditional academic degrees are losing their value due to online professional certificates.
How do university professors measure the attention span of students during large classes?
aciklama: Brian'ın boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle! Öğrencilerin materyalleri evde çalıştığı ve sınıfta tartıştığı ters yüz sınıf (flipped classroom) modeli çok daha iyidir" tespiti, Leo'nun iki saat boyunca sessizce oturmanın aktif analiz yerine ezberciliği teşvik ettiğini (B seçeneği) belirttiği tespitiyle birebir örtüşür.

soru_metni: Amy: I think standard standardized tests are a very poor measure of a person's actual intelligence. Kevin: ______ Amy: That's a fair point. An automated analytical exam is much easier to evaluate without any bias.
secenekler: Yes, standardized tests mostly measure a student's test-taking speed and memorization.
But they remain the most objective, scalable, and practical way to assess millions of applicants.
I scored very high on the mathematical reasoning section of the national exam.
Do you think project-based evaluations are fairer than multiple-choice examinations?
Many companies are now using cognitive ability tests during their recruitment processes.
aciklama: Amy'nin "Bu adil bir nokta. Otomatik analitik bir sınavı herhangi bir taraflılık olmadan değerlendirmek çok daha kolay" yanıtı, Kevin'ın standart sınavların hala milyonlarca adayı değerlendirmek için en objektif, ölçeklenebilir ve pratik yol (B seçeneği) olduğunu savunduğu tespitiyle uyumludur.

soru_metni: John: The rise of food delivery platforms has caused a massive increase in urban traffic congestion. Lisa: ______ John: Studies show they add thousands of slow-moving scooters to roads during peak rush hours.
secenekler: Food delivery services are usually much faster than going to a physical restaurant.
What is the main reason why these delivery platforms have made urban traffic worse?
Most delivery couriers work as independent contractors with no fixed hourly salary.
The city council should restrict delivery scooters from using dedicated public bus lanes.
I always order my dinner online because I am too tired to cook after work.
aciklama: John boşluktan sonra "Araştırmalar, en yoğun saatlerde yollara yavaş hareket eden binlerce motosiklet eklediklerini gösteriyor" diyerek trafiğin kötüleşme nedenini açıklamaktadır. Lisa'nın bu platformların trafiği neden daha da kötüleştirdiğini (B seçeneği) sorduğu soru akışa tam oturur.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I believe that reading physical novels stimulates brain connectivity more than watching digital media. George: ______ Evelyn: True. Because reading forces you to cognitively construct the sensory details of the scene yourself.
secenekler: Digital media is much faster at conveying complex visual details to a large audience.
Yes, because active reading requires the brain to continuously process abstract textual codes.
But both mediums can present highly complex, emotional, and thought-provoking narratives.
Do you prefer reading physical paperback books or using modern lightweight e-readers?
I think imagination is a talent that is determined by a person's genetics.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Doğru. Çünkü okumak sizi sahnenin duyusal detaylarını zihninizde yapılandırmaya zorluyor" açıklaması, George'un her iki mecranın da (hem kitapların hem de filmlerin) son derece karmaşık, duygusal ve düşündürücü anlatılar sunabileceğini (C seçeneği) belirterek getirdiği karşılaştırmaya verilen tamamlayıcı bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Arthur: Micro-plastics have been found inside pristine Arctic snow, thousands of miles from any cities. Clara: ______ Arthur: Lightweight plastic fibers are carried into the upper atmosphere by wind and deposited via precipitation.
secenekler: Most plastic pollution in polar regions comes from commercial fishing and shipping vessels.
How do these microscopic pollutants actually travel such immense distances through the air?
We should completely ban the manufacturing of single-use plastic packaging globally.
Are micro-plastics dangerous to polar wildlife when ingested through contaminated water?
I always carry a organic canvas tote bag when I go shopping at the supermarket.
aciklama: Arthur boşluktan sonra "Hafif plastik lifler rüzgarla üst atmosfere taşınır ve yağış yoluyla çökelir" diyerek taşınma mekanizmasını açıklamaktadır. Clara'nın bu mikroskobik kirleticilerin havada bu kadar büyük mesafeleri nasıl katettiğini (B seçeneği) sorduğu soru diyalogu bağlar.

soru_metni: Lucas: High schools should replace traditional physical education with comprehensive wellness education. Sophia: ______ Lucas: Exactly. Learning about sleep cycles, macronutrients, and mental coping mechanisms is far more useful for adulthood.
secenekler: I played competitive high school football and tennis when I was a teenager.
Yes, because fitness is a holistic state that involves much more than just playing team sports.
Traditional gym classes are very popular among active, athletic high school students.
Do you think public school districts have the financial budget to hire professional counselors?
Lifestyle diseases like cardiovascular disorders are rising rapidly among young people.
aciklama: Lucas'ın "Aynen öyle. Uyku döngülerini, makro besinleri ve zihinsel başa çıkma mekanizmalarını öğrenmek yetişkinlik için çok daha faydalıdır" tespiti, Sophia'nın zindeliğin (fitness) sadece takım sporları yapmaktan çok daha bütünsel (holistic) bir durum olduğunu belirterek spor derslerinin ötesine geçilmesi gerektiğini desteklediği B seçeneğindeki tespitiyle örtüşür.

soru_metni: Sarah: I'm trying to practice 'digital minimalism' by keeping my smartphone screen strictly in grayscale. Tom: ______ Sarah: It strips away the colorful visual rewards that trigger dopamine loops, making the phone boring.
secenekler: Modern smartphones are equipped with incredibly vibrant and high-resolution OLED displays.
How does changing the screen to grayscale actually reduce your phone usage?
I always use a blue light filter app in the evening to protect my eyesight.
Digital minimalism is just a temporary trend popular among Silicon Valley tech workers.
Which mobile application do you spend the most screen time on during a typical day?
aciklama: Sarah boşluktan sonra "Telefonun ekranını gri tonlamalı yapmanın, dopamin döngülerini tetikleyen renkli görsel ödülleri ortadan kaldırdığını ve telefonu sıkıcı hale getirdiğini" açıklamaktadır. Tom'un ekran rengini değiştirmenin telefon kullanımını nasıl azalttığını (B seçeneği) sorduğu soru bu açıklamayı doğrudan tetikler.

soru_metni: Oliver: The preservation of wild, uncultivated crop relatives is critical for our long-term food security. Emma: ______ Oliver: Exactly. They hold unique genetic traits that can protect crops from climate shifts and new pests.
secenekler: Genetically modified foods are much easier and cheaper to mass-produce globally.
Yes, because breeding them with commercial varieties can introduce vital environmental resilience.
Most modern grocery stores only offer a very narrow selection of apple and potato varieties.
Organic farming requires more manual labor and natural biological pest control methods.
How do scientific seed banks safely store endangered plant genetics for future centuries?
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Aynen öyle. Mahsulleri iklim değişikliklerinden ve yeni zararlılardan koruyabilecek benzersiz genetik özellikler barındırırlar" açıklaması, Emma'nın bunları ticari çeşitlerle melezlemenin hayati bir çevresel direnç (B seçeneğindeki environmental resilience) sağlayabileceğini belirttiği tespitiyle birebir örtüşür.

soru_metni: Jack: I think virtual reality platforms will eventually replace physical international business travel completely. Clara: ______ Jack: True, but for casual team updates and routine project check-ins, VR is far more efficient.
secenekler: High-quality VR headsets are still too heavy to wear comfortably for several hours.
Yes, because multinational corporations are trying to cut down on their travel budgets.
But building deep trust and negotiating complex contracts often require physical, face-to-face contact.
How much does a typical business-class ticket cost for a transatlantic flight nowadays?
Many business hotels are now closing their conference rooms to build coworking spaces.
aciklama: Jack'in boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak sıradan ekip güncellemeleri ve rutin proje kontrolleri için VR çok daha verimlidir" diyerek esnemesi, Clara'nın derin güven oluşturmak ve karmaşık sözleşmeleri müzakere etmek için yüz yüze temasın (B seçeneğindeki face-to-face contact) şart olduğunu belirttiği C seçeneğindeki eleştirisine hak verdiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Nancy: I started using a specialized blue light filter on all my digital monitors after sunset. George: ______ Nancy: Yes, my eyes feel much less strained, and I find myself falling asleep far more easily.
secenekler: Blue light filters often make the display colors look too warm and orange.
Have you noticed any genuine improvement in your daily sleep patterns or eye comfort?
I always shut down my computer completely at least two hours before going to bed.
Exposure to blue light late at night has been linked to severe sleep phase delays.
Most modern laptop operating systems have a built-in automatic night shift feature.
aciklama: Nancy'nin "Evet, gözlerimde çok daha az yorgunluk hissediyorum ve daha kolay uykuya daldığımı fark ediyorum" yanıtı, George'un bu filtrenin uyku düzeninde veya göz konforunda gerçek bir iyileşme (B seçeneğindeki genuine improvement) sağlayıp sağlamadığını merak ettiği B seçeneğindeki sorusunun cevabıdır.

soru_metni: David: I believe the systemic exploitation in the gig economy can only be fixed through federal labor laws. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. If gig platforms are not legally mandated to provide benefits, they simply won't.
secenekler: Many freelancers actually enjoy the absolute flexibility of gig work structures.
Yes, because voluntary corporate codes of conduct have proven entirely ineffective for worker rights.
The government should offer tax incentives to companies that hire full-time staff instead.
How do freelance delivery drivers calculate their net income after vehicle depreciation?
Most labor unions are already organizing major strikes against prominent ride-sharing platforms.
aciklama: David'in "Aynen öyle. Şirketler yasal olarak yan hakları sağlamaya zorlanmazlarsa, bundan kaçınmaya devam edecekler" açıklaması, Sarah'nın şirketlerin gönüllü rehber ilkelerinin işçi hakları için nadiren etkili olduğunu (B seçeneğindeki voluntary corporate guidelines) belirttiği tespitiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Paul: Noise-canceling headphones are an absolute necessity for modern open-plan office workers. Laura: ______ Paul: True, but without them, the constant background chatter makes deep work practically impossible.
secenekler: I prefer working in absolute silence inside a private, enclosed office cabin.
Yes, but they can isolate you too much, making spontaneous team collaboration much harder.
Noise-canceling technology has become incredibly cheap and accessible for consumers lately.
Most modern office layouts are intentionally designed to encourage visual transparency.
How long does the battery of a typical high-end noise-canceling headset actually last?
aciklama: Paul'ün boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak onlar olmadan sürekli arka plan gürültüsü derinlemesine çalışmayı (deep work) neredeyse imkansız hale getiriyor" demesi, Laura'nın bu kulaklıkların insanı ekipten aşırı izole edebileceğini ve anlık ekip çalışmasını zorlaştırabileceğini (B seçeneğindeki isolate you too much) belirttiği eleştirisine karşı bir savunmadır.

soru_metni: Kevin: Standardized entrance testing has completely narrowed down the educational curriculum in schools. Rachel: ______ Kevin: Exactly. Teachers end up 'teaching to the test' instead of fostering true creativity and critical analysis.
secenekler: Standardized exams are the only objective way to evaluate student performance globally.
Yes, and subjects that are not tested, like art and music, are often entirely neglected.
I scored ninety-eight points on the national science entrance exam myself.
Do you think essay-based evaluations are fairer than multiple-choice standard tests?
Many schools are investing heavily in modern STEM and coding laboratories now.
aciklama: Kevin'ın "Aynen öyle. Öğretmenler yaratıcılığı ve eleştirel analizi teşvik etmek yerine sadece sınava yönelik eğitim veriyorlar" açıklaması, Rachel'ın sınavda sorulmayan sanat ve müzik gibi derslerin tamamen ihmal edildiğini (B seçeneği) belirten tespitini onaylar ve somutlaştırır.

soru_metni: Lily: I find it fascinating how deep-sea bioluminescent organisms can produce cold light with zero heat. Sam: ______ Lily: Yes, they use a highly efficient chemical reaction involving luciferin substrate and luciferase enzymes.
secenekler: Most deep-sea organisms are bioluminescent to attract prey or communicate in absolute darkness.
Is there a specific biochemical pathway behind this extremely efficient cold light generation?
I watched an interesting documentary about bioluminescent fungi in a Japanese forest.
Bioluminescent genetics are now being researched for sustainable kentsel lighting projects.
How do fireflies manage to flash their lights in perfect, beautiful synchronization?
aciklama: Lily'nin boşluktan sonra "Evet, lusiferin substratı ve lusiferaz enzimlerini içeren son derece verimli bir kimyasal reaksiyon kullanırlar" diyerek süreci açıklaması, Sam'in bu soğuk ışık üretiminin (cold light generation) arkasında özel bir biyokimyasal yolak (B seçeneğindeki specific biochemical pathway) olup olmadığını sorduğu B seçeneğiyle doğrudan örtüşür.

soru_metni: Alice: Implementing strict congestion pricing in downtown areas is the most effective way to ease urban traffic. Bob: ______ Alice: That's a valid concern, which is why the revenues must be directly reinvested into making public transit cheaper.
secenekler: Congestion pricing policies have been highly successful in London, Milan, and Singapore.
But wouldn't that place an unfair, regressive financial burden on low-income commuters?
I prefer driving my personal car even if I have to pay high hourly parking fees downtown.
How do municipal cameras actually monitor which cars enter the pricing zones?
Most city residents would support the policy if it visibly reduced air pollution levels.
aciklama: Alice'in "Bu haklı bir endişe, bu yüzden elde edilen gelirlerin doğrudan toplu taşımayı daha ucuz hale getirmek için yeniden yatırılması gerekir" açıklaması, Bob'un sıkışıklık ücretinin düşük gelirli çalışanlar üzerinde adaletsiz bir finansal yük (B seçeneğindeki regressive financial burden) yaratacağına dair getirdiği sosyo-ekonomik eleştirisine bir çözümdür.

soru_metni: James: I think the constant, obsessive pursuit of productivity is actually destroying our creative capacity. Emily: ______ James: Exactly. True creative breakthroughs require unstructured idle time and boredom for the mind to wander.
secenekler: Many tech startups are trying to implement a four-day workweek for developers lately.
Yes, when every single hour is optimized and scheduled, there is no space for random experimentation.
I always use a advanced time-tracking application to organize my daily corporate tasks.
Do you think creative thinking is a skill that can be systematically taught in high schools?
Most professional artists are highly disciplined and work on a very strict daily schedule.
aciklama: James'in "Aynen öyle. Gerçek yaratıcı atılımlar, zihnin serbestçe gezinmesi için yapılandırılmamış boş zaman ve can sıkıntısı gerektirir" tespiti, Emily'nin her saatin optimize edilmesinin rastgele deneyler yapmaya (B seçeneğindeki random experimentation) yer bırakmadığını belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrular. soru_metni: Amy: I've noticed that many students prefer studying in groups rather than individually. Tom: ______ Amy: Exactly. Plus, explaining concepts to others actually helps solidify your own understanding.
secenekler: I think group study is highly distracting and unproductive.
Yes, because it allows them to share different perspectives and resources.
Most libraries have dedicated silent zones for individual study.
How many students are typically in a university study group?
I always study alone in my bedroom with the door closed.
aciklama: Tom'un boşlukta grup çalışmasının avantajlarından, yani farklı bakış açıları ve kaynakları paylaşmaktan (B seçeneği) bahsetmesi gerekir. Amy'nin "Exactly" (Aynen öyle) diyerek bu duruma katılması ve "Plus..." (Ayrıca...) diyerek başkalarına kavramları açıklamanın kendi anlayışını pekiştirdiği avantajını eklemesi akışı mükemmel tamamlar.

soru_metni: David: I believe that learning to cultivate a home garden should be taught in schools. Sarah: ______ David: Exactly. It connects children with the origins of their food and teaches them patience.
secenekler: Most urban schools do not have any physical space for gardens.
Yes, because it fosters environmental awareness and healthy eating habits.
I think learning computer coding is more useful than gardening.
How much does a typical package of organic tomato seeds cost?
Most children prefer playing sports over working in the dirt.
aciklama: David'in boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle. Çocukları yiyeceklerinin kökenleriyle bağdaştırır ve onlara sabrı öğretir" demesi, Sarah'nın okul bahçesi yetiştirmenin çevresel farkındalık ve sağlıklı beslenme alışkanlıkları (B seçeneği) üzerindeki faydalarını belirttiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Olivia: The integration of augmented reality in school biology lessons is absolutely revolutionary. Ethan: ______ Olivia: True, but seeing a three-dimensional interactive human heart is far more memorable than a flat diagram.
secenekler: I always preferred chemistry experiments over biology classes in school.
But aren't high-quality AR systems still too expensive for public schools?
Augmented reality is expanding rapidly into the video gaming industry.
Many students complain that AR glasses make them feel slightly nauseous.
I think traditional textbooks are still necessary for learning detailed anatomy.
aciklama: Olivia'nın "True, but..." (Doğru, ama...) diyerek etkileşimli 3D insan kalbini görmenin düz bir diyagramdan çok daha akılda kalıcı olduğunu savunması, Ethan'ın AR sistemlerinin devlet okulları için hala çok pahalı olduğu (B seçeneği) yönündeki mali çekincesini onayladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Sophia: I find that keeping a physical photo album is much more nostalgic than storing photos in the cloud. Liam: ______ Sophia: Exactly. Flipping through physical pages triggers memories in a way that scrolling on a screen cannot.
secenekler: Cloud storage allows you to share photos with friends instantly.
Yes, because holding a tangible book of memories feels deeply personal.
I always use my smartphone to take high-resolution videos.
How much does it cost to print fifty high-quality digital photos?
Most people do not have the physical space to store several albums.
aciklama: Sophia'nın "Aynen öyle. Okuyucu baskısı olmadığı için kendinize karşı tamamen dürüst olabilirsiniz" yanıtı, Liam'ın anıların somut bir kitabını tutmanın derin kişisel hissettirdiğini (B seçeneği) belirten yorumuyla birebir örtüşür.

soru_metni: Emma: I think that fast-food advertisements targeted at children should be legally banned. Lucas: ______ Emma: That's a fair point. However, protecting public health and reducing childhood obesity should take priority.
secenekler: Most fast-food companies spend millions of dollars on television advertising.
But wouldn't that cause a severe financial loss for television networks?
Many parents are already choosing healthier snack options for their kids.
Childhood obesity is a very complex issue with many contributing factors.
I always try to cook healthy meals at home instead of buying fast food.
aciklama: Emma'nın boşluktan sonra "Bu adil bir nokta. Ancak halk sağlığını korumak ve çocukluk çağı obezitesini azaltmak öncelikli olmalıdır" açıklaması, Lucas'ın bu tür reklam yasaklarının televizyon kanalları için ciddi finansal kayıplara (B seçeneği) yol açacağını belirttiği ekonomik kaygısını doğrular.

soru_metni: Zoe: The popularity of online cycling maps has made urban commuting accessible to new riders. Ryan: ______ Zoe: True. It is so convenient that even people who were afraid of traffic are cycling to work now.
secenekler: Most road bikes require a lot of regular maintenance to stay safe.
Yes, it has simplified the process of finding safe, designated bike lanes.
I always buy my cycling gear from the local sports shop nearby.
Urban cycling is just a temporary summer trend driven by active lifestyle blogs.
How much does a high-quality commuter bicycle cost online nowadays?
aciklama: Zoe'nin "Doğru. O kadar pratik ki trafikten korkan insanlar bile artık bisikletle işe gidiyor" tespiti, Ryan'ın çevrimiçi haritaların güvenli ve belirlenmiş bisiklet yollarını bulmayı (B seçeneği) kolaylaştırdığına dair pratiklik vurgusunu destekler.

soru_metni: Leo: I think city centers should offer free secure bicycle parking stations. Maya: ______ Leo: That's a valid concern, but the reduction in car parking demand would free up valuable municipal space.
secenekler: Many citizens already commute to work using electric kick scooters.
But wouldn't building those secure stations require significant public funding?
I always lock my bicycle to a lamppost because there are no racks.
Bicycle theft is a major problem in almost every modern megacity.
Most cyclists would support the idea if it kept their bikes dry.
aciklama: Leo'nun "Bu haklı bir endişe, ancak araç otopark talebindeki azalma belediyeye ait değerli alanları boşa çıkaracaktır" savunması, Maya'nın bu güvenli istasyonları inşa etmenin önemli miktarda kamu fonu (B seçeneği) gerektireceği yönündeki mali endişesine verilmiş mantıklı bir yanıttır.

soru_metni: Lily: I believe that learning to write poetry can significantly improve an engineer's design thinking. James: ______ Lily: Exactly. It forces you to look at everyday objects from entirely new, creative angles.
secenekler: Poetry is a skill that can only be appreciated by literature students.
Yes, because metaphoric thinking helps conceptualize complex, abstract problems.
I always read classic poetry books to relax during my weekends.
Most engineering curriculums do not focus enough on humanities classes.
Design thinking is a natural cognitive trait that cannot be easily trained.
aciklama: Lily'nin "Aynen öyle. Sizi günlük nesnelere tamamen yeni, yaratıcı açılardan bakmaya zorlar" açıklaması, James'in metaforik düşünmenin karmaşık ve soyut problemleri kavramsallaştırmaya (B seçeneğindeki conceptualize complex abstract problems) yardımcı olduğunu belirttiği tespitiyle mükemmel bağlanır.

soru_metni: Anna: I've started using a specialized smart thermometer to monitor my indoor air quality. David: ______ Anna: Yes, it alerts me when carbon dioxide or humidity levels are too high, helping me ventilate better.
secenekler: Most smart devices are highly inaccurate because of sensor degradation.
Has having access to that real-time air quality data changed your ventilation habits?
I always try to open my windows for ten minutes every single morning.
How much does a premium smart air monitor cost on the market?
I prefer using a traditional air purifier with a HEPA filter instead.
aciklama: Anna'nın "Evet, karbondioksit veya nem seviyeleri çok yüksek olduğunda beni uyararak daha iyi havalandırmama yardımcı oluyor" cevabı, David'in bu gerçek zamanlı hava kalitesi verilerine (real-time air quality data) erişmenin havalandırma alışkanlıklarını değiştirip değiştirmediğini sorduğu B seçeneğindeki sorusunun doğrudan karşılığıdır.

soru_metni: Chloe: I think that standard school textbooks should be entirely replaced by interactive tablets. Daniel: ______ Chloe: True, but for interactive diagrams, instant dictionary lookups, and weight reduction, it is unmatched.
secenekler: Most teachers already use interactive smartboards in their lessons.
But wouldn't that significantly increase the screen time and eye strain for students?
Online textbooks became highly popular globally during the pandemic years.
Many students do not have access to high-speed internet connections at home.
Purchasing tablets for every student requires a massive municipal budget.
aciklama: Chloe'nin "Doğru, ancak etkileşimli diyagramlar, anında sözlük aramaları ve ağırlık azaltma açısından rakipsizdir" savunması, Daniel'ın bu uygulamanın öğrenciler için ekran süresini ve göz yorgunluğunu (B seçeneğindeki screen time and eye strain) önemli ölçüde artırıp artırmayacağını sorduğu endişesine yönelik bir yumuşatmadır.

soru_metni: Victor: I think local councils should replace asphalt driveways with grass pavers in suburban homes. Rachel: ______ Victor: Because it reduces the urban heat island effect and allows rainwater to recharge local groundwater.
secenekler: Grass pavers are much more difficult and expensive to keep weed-free.
What is the primary ecological benefit of grass pavers over traditional asphalt?
Asphalt is still the most durable and cost-effective material for heavily used paths.
How much does it cost to pave a standard suburban driveway with grass pavers?
Most modern suburban architects prefer using eco-friendly natural materials.
aciklama: Victor'ın boşluktan sonra "Çünkü kentsel ısı adası etkisini azaltır ve yağmur suyunun yerel yeraltı suyunu beslemesini sağlar" diyerek ekolojik faydayı açıklaması, Rachel'ın çim döşemelerin geleneksel asfalta göre temel ekolojik faydasını (B seçeneğindeki primary ecological benefit) sorduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paul: Keeping our smartphone chargers plugged in all day is a silent waste of energy. Diana: ______ Paul: Exactly. We are talking about millions of chargers globally drawing standby power needlessly.
secenekler: I always unplug my charger as soon as my phone battery reaches eighty percent.
Yes, even when not connected to a phone, they still draw a small amount of phantom electricity.
Most modern chargers are designed to be highly energy-efficient nowadays.
How much does a typical fast charger add to your monthly utility bill?
I think the government should enforce automatic shut-off chips on all charging devices.
aciklama: Paul'ün "Aynen öyle. Küresel ölçekte milyonlarca şarj cihazının gereksiz yere yedek güç çekmesinden bahsediyoruz" açıklaması, Diana'nın şarj cihazlarının telefona bağlı değilken bile küçük bir hayalet elektrik (phantom electricity) çektiğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki teknik tespitini doğrular.

soru_metni: Brian: The extreme compartmentalization in corporate departments prevents creative synergy. Leo: ______ Brian: Exactly! We need more cross-functional teams where employees from different departments solve problems together.
secenekler: Corporate structures have advanced more in the last decade than ever before.
That's a valid point. Departments often operate in isolated silos, ignoring mutual goals.
I think getting an MBA degree requires too much focus on theoretical management.
Many companies are now offering broad training programs for entry-level staff.
How do HR managers evaluate the creative capacity of teams across different branches?
aciklama: Brian'ın boşluktan sonra "Aynen öyle! Farklı departmanlardan çalışanların sorunları birlikte çözdüğü daha fazla çapraz fonksiyonel ekibe ihtiyacımız var" tespiti, Leo'nun departmanların genellikle yalıtılmış silolarda çalışarak ortak hedefleri görmezden geldiği (B seçeneğindeki isolated silos) yönündeki eleştirisini doğrudan onaylar.

soru_metni: Amy: I struggled immensely with the speaking section of the IELTS exam. Kevin: ______ Amy: Mostly because the examiner asked very abstract philosophical questions that were hard to answer instantly.
secenekler: You should practice mock interviews under strict exam conditions to reduce anxiety.
What do you think was the primary reason for your difficulty in that section?
Speaking is generally considered the most direct part of language proficiency tests.
Did you have a friendly and encouraging examiner during your test session?
I scored a perfect band score of eight on the writing section of the IELTS myself.
aciklama: Amy'nin boşluktan sonra "Çoğunlukla sınav görevlisinin anında yanıtlanması zor olan son derece soyut felsefi sorular sorması nedeniyle" demesi, Kevin'ın ona bu bölümde yaşadığı zorluğun birincil nedenini (primary reason) sorduğu B seçeneğini gerektirir.

soru_metni: John: I think all public high school admissions should be based on regional project portfolios, not standardized tests. Lisa: ______ John: Exactly. A single standardized test cannot possibly capture a student's years of practical talent and growth.
secenekler: Portfolios are much harder and more subjective to grade than standardized tests.
Yes, because a portfolio shows a comprehensive, long-term picture of a student's abilities.
Many private high schools already use portfolios alongside standard entrance exams.
How would middle schools adapt their curriculums to help students build these portfolios?
Most parents prefer the objective nature of multiple-choice entrance exams.
aciklama: John'un "Kesinlikle. Tek bir standart sınav, bir öğrencinin yıllarca süren pratik yeteneğini ve gelişimini yakalayamaz" tespiti, Lisa'nın portfolyoların öğrencinin yeteneklerinin kapsamlı ve uzun vadeli bir resmini (long-term picture) gösteridğini belirttiği B seçeneğini doğrudan onaylar.

soru_metni: Evelyn: I've noticed that I feel much more distracted on days when I keep my phone notifications turned on. George: ______ Evelyn: Exactly. Every minor buzz pulls your attention away, forcing your brain to constantly refocus.
secenekler: Smartphone manufacturers are constantly updating their notification settings.
That's because notifications trigger cognitive task-switching, which degrades focus.
I always turn off my digital devices when I am at the library studying.
How many notifications do you typically receive on your social media accounts?
I think push notifications are a great tool for staying updated on breaking news.
aciklama: Evelyn'ın "Kesinlikle. Her ufak titreşim dikkatinizi başka yere çekerek beyninizi sürekli yeniden odaklanmaya zorlar" tespiti, George'un bildirimlerin odağı bozan bilişsel görev değişimi (cognitive task-switching) tetiklediğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki tespiti doğrular.

soru_metni: Arthur: I think high schools should teach basic cooking and meal prep skills, like budgeting and nutrition. Clara: ______ Arthur: Absolutely. Knowing how to prepare healthy meals on a budget is crucial for independent adult life.
secenekler: Restaurant meals are becoming extremely expensive in major metropolitan cities nowadays.
Yes, these are essential life skills that can significantly improve adult health and finances.
I didn't learn how to cook a simple pasta dish until I moved to university.
Do you think high school students would find cooking classes too boring?
Many schools are already focusing more on advanced computer literacy classes instead.
aciklama: Arthur'un boşluktan sonra "Kesinlikle. Kısıtlı bir bütçeyle sağlıklı yemekler hazırlamayı bilmek bağımsız yetişkin yaşamı için kritik öneme sahiptir" demesi, Clara'nın bu temel yaşam becerilerinin (essential life skills) yetişkin sağlığını ve finansını iyileştirebileceğini belirttiği B seçeneğindeki tespitiyle tam uyumludur.

soru_metni: Lucas: I believe the rise of autonomous drones will make traditional search and rescue dogs obsolete. Sophia: ______ Lucas: True, but for sniffing out survivors under dense concrete rubble, dogs are still far more reliable.
secenekler: Drone technology is already being used in forestry to monitor forest fires.
But can drones replicate a dog's extraordinary sense of smell and physical agility in ruins?
Yes, because thermal imaging drones can cover massive disaster zones in minutes.
I am currently volunteering as a drone operator for a local search group.
Most rescue teams prefer using high-tech sensors instead of relying on animals.
aciklama: Lucas'ın boşluktan sonra "Doğru, ancak yoğun beton enkaz altındaki kazazedelerin kokusunu almak için köpekler hala çok daha güvenilirdir" diyerek esnemesi, Sophia'nın drone'ların köpeklerin olağanüstü koku alma duyusunu ve fiziksel çevikliğini (B seçeneği) taklit edip edemeyeceğini sorguladığı eleştirisini kabul ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Sarah: The transition to solar energy has some unexpected local ecological impacts. Tom: ______ Sarah: Exactly. Giant solar farms can disrupt local desert soil ecosystems and native vegetation.
secenekler: Because solar panels require a lot of silicon and water to manufacture?
Yes, especially when they cover massive natural desert habitats with artificial structures.
Many countries are leading the way in building rooftop solar grids in urban areas.
How much electricity can a single residential solar panel generate during winter?
I think wind energy is a much cleaner and safer alternative to solar farms.
aciklama: Sarah'nın "Aynen öyle. Dev güneş tarlaları yerel çöl toprağı ekosistemlerini ve yerli bitki örtüsünü bozabilir" tespiti, Tom'un güneş tarlalarının yapay yapılarla devasa doğal çöl habitatlarını kaplamasının (B seçeneği) fiziksel etkisine değindiği tespitiyle kusursuz örtüşür.

soru_metni: Oliver: I find it hard to maintain my reading habit when working long corporate hours. Emma: ______ Oliver: That's an excellent idea. Listening to a book during my daily commute would save a lot of time.
secenekler: You should look for quiet libraries that are open late in the evening.
Have you tried listening to audiobooks during your daily train commute?
I always try to read at least ten pages of a physical book before going to sleep.
Working long corporate hours is usually extremely exhausting and leaves very little energy.
Most modern bookstores have a very cozy reading section with free coffee.
aciklama: Oliver'ın "Bu mükemmel bir fikir. Günlük yolculuğum sırasında bir kitap dinlemek çok zaman kazandıracaktır" demesi, Emma'nın ona tren yolculuğu sırasında sesli kitap dinlemeyi (B seçeneği) önerdiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Jack: Most people don't realize how much carbon is emitted by storing files in the cloud. Clara: ______ Jack: Storing gigabytes of data continuously requires massive, power-hungry servers to stay online and cooled.
secenekler: I always delete my old photos to free up storage space in my phone.
How does storing digital files actually generate physical carbon emissions in the real world?
Cloud storage companies are making billions of dollars from monthly user subscriptions.

Forest conservation is crucial for preserving local animal populations in concrete regions.
